Avodah Zarah 25a:18-26a:3: Lo tityayched ishsha immahem, bemay askinan? ilema bechad, dichvavta gabbe yisrael mi shere? vehatnan: "lo yityayched ish echad im shete nashim"!

Ella bitlata. dichvavta gabbe yisrael, bifrutzim mi shere? vehatnan: "aval ishsha achat mityaychedet im shene anashim", veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella bichsherim, aval bifrutzim afillu asara name la. maase haya vehotziuha asara bemitta!
La, tzericha beishto immo. goy en ishto meshammarto, aval yisrael ishto meshammarto.
Vetippok leh mishshum shefichut damim! amar rabbi yirmeya: beishsha chashuva askinan, demiratti minna. rav idi amar: ishsha kele zayynah aleha.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu: ishsha chashuva ben anashim, vesheenah chashuva ben hannashim.
Tanya kevavteh derav idi bar avin: haishsha, af al pi shehashshalom immah, lo tityayched immahen, mippene shechashudin al haarayot.

Lo yityayched adam immahen. tanu rabbanan: yisrael shennizdammen lo goy badderech — toflo limino. rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: besayif — toflo limino, bemakkel — toflo lismolo.
Hayu olin bemaale o yordin birida, lo yehe yisrael lematta vegoy lemala, ella yisrael lemala vegoy lematta, veal yashuach lefanav, shemma yarotz et gulegolto.
Shealo lehechan holech — yarchiv lo et hadderech, kederech sheasa yaakov avinu leesav harasha, dichtiv: "ad asher avo el adoni seira",

Maase betalmide rabbi akiva shehayu holchim lichziv, pagu bahen listim, amru lahen: lean attem holchim? amru lahen: leakko. kevan shehiggiu lichziv, pershu. amru lahen: talmide mi attem? amru lahen: talmide rabbi akiva. amru lahen: ashre rabbi akiva vetalmidav shello paga bahen adam ra meolam.

Leve torta, pegau beh gannave, amaru leh: lean kaazlat? amar lahen: lefumebdita. ki meta leve torta, paresh. amaru leh: talmida dihuda rammaa at! amar lehu: yaditu leh? yehe raava delihvo hanhu inashe beshamteh.

Azalu avadu genevata esrin vetarten shenin vela atzlachu, kevan dachazo, ato kullehu tevau shamtayyhu, vahava behu chad girdena dela ata lesharoye shammeteh, achleh arya. hayeynu deamri inashe: girdana dela tayyzan, shatta (batzir mishshene) [betzira mishsheneh].
Ta chazi, ma ben gannave vavel velistin deeretz yisrael.
Bekhorot 29a:2-11: Gemara may tama? hay nefish tircheh, vehay la nefish tircheh.
Ben tam uven baal mum. bishlama baal mum — mishshum deka share leh, ella tam ammay? deim ken, ate lemichshedeh, veamri: hay baal mum tam hu, vehay deka share leh — mishshum agra.
I hachi, tam name amri: baal mum hu, vehay dela kashare leh savar ki hechi delishkol agreh zimna achariti! chad zimna takkinu le rabbanan, tere zimne la takkinu le rabbanan.
Mishna hannotel secharo ladun — dinav betelim, lehaid — edotav betelin, lehazzot ulekaddesh — memav me meara, efro efer mikle.
Im haya kohen, metammeehu mitterumato — maachilo umashko vesacho, veim haya zaken — markivo al hachamor, venoten lo secharo kefoel.
Gemara menahane mille? amar rav yehuda amar rav, deamar kera: "ree limmadti etchem vegomer", ma ani bechinnam — af attem bechinnam.

Tanya name hachi: "kaasher tzivvani Adonai elohay" — ma ani bechinnam, af attem bechinnam. uminnayin sheim lo matza bechinnam sheyyelammed besachar? talmud lomar: "emet kene". uminnayin shello yomar: keshem shellemadtiha besachar kach alammedenna besachar? talmud lomar: "emet kene veal timkor".
Lehazzot ulekaddesh — memav me meara, efro efer mikle. ureminhu: hamekaddesh beme chattat beefer chattat — hare zo mekuddeshet, af al pi shehu yisrael!
Amar abbaye: la kashya — kan bischar havaa umilluy, kan bischar hazzaa vekiddush.
Dayka name, dekatane hacha "lehazzot ulekaddesh", vehatam katane "hamekaddesh beme chattat uveefer chattat", shema minna.
Berakhot 47a:4-11: Amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav: en hamesubbin rashshain leechol kelum ad sheyyitom habbotzea. yatev rav safra vekaamar: "litom" ittemar.
Lemay nafka minna? shechayyayv adam lomar bilshon rabbo.
Tanu rabbanan: shenayim mamtinin ze laze bakkeara, shelosha — en mamtinin. habbotzea hu poshet yado techilla, veim ba lachalok kavod lerabbo o lemi sheggadol hemennu — harshut beyado.

Rabba bar bar chana hava asek leh livreh be rav shemuel bar rav kattina, kadem veyatev vekamatne leh livreh: en habbotzea rashshay livtzoa ad sheyyichle "amen" mippi haonim. rav chisda amar mippi rov haonim.
Amar lo rame bar chama: may shena rubba — deakkatti la kalya beracha, miuta name la kalya beracha?
Amar leh: sheani omer, kol haone "amen" yoter midday — eno ella toe.
Tanu rabbanan: en onin lo "amen" chatufa, velo "amen" ketufa, velo "amen" yetoma, velo yizrok beracha mippiv.
Ben azzay omer: kol haone "amen" yetoma — yihyu banav yetomim, chatufa — yitchattefu yamav, ketufa — yitkattefu yamav. vechol hammaarich beamen" — maarichin lo yamav ushenotav.

Mishnah Mikvaot 1:2-5:
Mille vichli tame veshata tahor, tame. mille vichli tame umille vichli tahor, tame. mille vichli tame venafal kikkar shel teruma, im hediach, tame. veim lo hediach, tahor: 
Naflu mayim temeim veshata tahor, tame. naflu mayim temeim umille vichli tahor, tame. naflu mayim temeim venafal kikkar shel teruma, im hediach, tame. veim lo hediach, tahor. rabbi shimon omer, ben shehediach ben shello hediach, tame: 
Nafal letochan met, o shehalach bahen hattame, veshata tahor, tahor. echad me gevaim, me vorot, me shichim, me mearot, me tamtziyyot sheppasku, umikvaot sheen bahem arbaim sea, bishat haggeshamim hakkol tahor. pasku haggeshamim, hakkerovim lair veladderech, temeim. veharchokim, tehorin, ad sheyyehallechu rov bene adam: 
Meematay tohoratan. bet shammay omrim, mishsheyyirbu veyishtofu. uvet hillel omrim, rabbu af al pi shello shatfu. rabbi shimon omer, shatfu af al pi shello rabbu. kesherin lachalla velittol mehen layyadayim:
Mishnah Mikvaot 1:6-2:2:
Lemala mehen, me tamtziyyot shello fasku. shata tame veshata tahor, tahor. shata tame umille vichli tahor, tahor. shata tame venafal kikkar shel teruma, af al pi shehediach, tahor. mille vichli tame veshata tahor, tahor. mille vichli tame umille vichli tahor, tahor. mille vichli tame venafal kikkar shel teruma, af al pi shehediach, tahor. naflu mayim temeim veshata tahor, tahor. naflu mayim temeim umille vichli tahor, tahor. naflu mayim temeim venafal kikkar shel teruma, af al pi shehediach, tahor. kesherim latteruma velittol mehem layyadayim: 
Lemala mehen, mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea, shebbo tovlin umatbilin. lemala mehen, mayan shemmemav muatin verabbu alav mayim sheuvin, shave lammikve letaher beashboren, velammayan lehatebil bo bechol shehu: 
Lemala mehen, mayim mukkin, shehen metaharin bezochalin. lemala mehen, mayim chayyim, shebbahen tevila lazzavim, vehazzaya lamtzoraim, uchesherim lekaddesh mehen me chattat: 
Hattame sheyyarad litbol, safek taval safek lo taval, afillu taval, safek yesh bo arbaim sea safek en bo. shene mikvaot, echad yesh bo arbaim sea veechad sheen bo, taval beachad mehem veeno yodea beeze mehen taval, sefeko tame: 
Mikve shennimdad venimtza chaser, kol tohorot shennaasu al gabbav lemafrea, ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim, temeot. bamme devarim amurim, betuma chamura. aval betuma kalla, kegon achal ochalim temeim, veshata mashkin temeim, ba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvim, o shennaflu al rosho veal rubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin, veyarad litbol, safek taval safek lo taval, afillu taval, safek yesh bo arbaim sea safek en bo. shene mikvaot, echad yesh bo arbaim sea, veechad sheen bo, taval beachad mehen veeno yodea beeze mehen taval, sefeko tahor. rabbi yose metamme, sherabbi yose omer, kol davar shehu vechezkat tuma, leolam hu vifsulo, ad sheyyivvada shettahar. aval sefeko littame uletamme, tahor:
Mishnah Mikvaot 2:3-6:
Sefek mayim sheuvin shettiharu chachamim, safek naflu, safek lo naflu, afillu naflu, safek yesh bahem arbaim sea safek en bahem, shene mikvaot, echad yesh bo arbaim sea veechad en bo, nafal leachad mehen veeno yodea leeze mehen nafal, sefeko tahor, mippene sheyyesh lo vamme yitle. hayu shenehem pechutim mearbaim sea, venafal leachad mehem veeno yodea leeze mehen nafal, sefeko tame, mippene sheen lo vamme yitle: 
Rabbi eliezer omer, reviit mayim sheuvin battechilla, poslin et hammikve, ushelosha luggin al pene hammayim. vachachamim omrim, ben battechilla ben bassof, shiuro shelosha luggin: 
Mikve sheyyesh bo shalosh gummot shel mayim sheuvin shel log log, im yadua shennafal letocho arbaim sein mayim kesherin ad shello higgiu laggumma hashshelishit, kasher. veim lav, pasul. verabbi shimon machshir, mippene shehu chemikve samuch lemikve: 
Hamesannek et hattit latztzedadin umashchu mimmennu shelosha luggin, kasher. haya tolesh umashchu mimmennu shelosha luggin, pasul. verabbi shimon machshir, mippene shello nitkavven lishov:
Mishnah Mikvaot 2:7-10:
Hammanniach kankannim berosh haggag lenaggevan venitmalleu mayim, rabbi eliezer omer, im onat geshamim hi, im yesh bo chimat mayim babbor, yeshabber. veim lav, lo yeshabber. rabbi yehoshua omer, ben kach uven kach yeshabber, o yichpe, aval lo yeare: 
Hassayyad sheshshachach atzitz babbor venitmalle mayim, im hayu hammayim tzafim al gabbav kol shehu, yeshabber. veim lav, lo yeshabber, divre rabbi eliezer. verabbi yehoshua omer, ben kach uven kach yeshabber: 
Hamesadder kankannim betoch habbor venitmalleu mayim, af al pi shebbala habbor et memav, hare ze yeshabber: 
Mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mayim vatit, rabbi eliezer omer, matbilin bammayim veen matbilin battit. rabbi yehoshua omer, bammayim uvattit. beeze tit matbilin. betit shehammayim tzafim al gabbav. hayu hammayim mitztzad echad, mode rabbi yehoshua shemmatbilin bammayim veen matbilin battit. beeze tit amru. betit shehakkane yored meelav, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, mekom sheen kene hammidda omed. abba elazar ben dolay omer, mekom shehammishkolet yoredet. rabbi eliezer omer, hayyored befi chavit. rabbi shimon omer, hannichnas bishfoferet hannod. rabbi elazar bar tzadok omer, hannimdad ballog:
Mishnah Mikvaot 3:1-4:1:
Rabbi yose omer, shene mikvaot sheen bahem arbaim sea, venaflu laze log umechetza velaze log umechetza venitarvu, kesherim, mippene shello nikra alehen shem pesul. aval mikve sheen bo arbaim sea venaflu vo shelosha luggin venechelak lishnayim, pasul, mippene shennikra alav shem pesul. verabbi yehoshua machshir, shehaya rabbi yehoshua omer, kol mikve sheen bo arbaim sea venaflu lo shelosha luggin vechasar afillu kortov, kasher, mippene shechasru lo shelosha luggin. vachachamim omrim, leolam hu vifsulo, ad sheyyetze mimmennu meloo vaod: 
Ketzad. habbor shebbechatzer venaflu lo shelosha luggin, leolam hu vifsulo, ad sheyyetze mimmennu meloo vaod, o ad sheyyaamid bechatzer arbaim sea veyitharu haelyonim min hattachtonim. rabbi elazar ben azarya posel, ella im ken pakak: 
Bor shehu male mayim sheuvin vehaamma nichneset lo veyotza mimmennu, leolam hu vifsulo, ad sheyyitchashshev shello nishtayyer min harishonim shelosha luggin. shenayim shehayu mattilin lammikve, ze log umechetza vaze log umechetza, hassochet et kesuto umattil mimmekomot harebe, vehammeare min hatztzartzur umattil mimmekomot harebe, rabbi akiva machshir, vachachamim poslin. amar rabbi akiva, lo amru mattilin, ella mattil. amru lo, lo chach velo chach amru, ella shennaflu lo shelosha luggin: 
Mikkeli echad, mishshenayim umishshelosha, mitztarfin. umearbaa, en mitztarfin. baal keri hachole shennaflu alav tisha kabbin mayim, vetahor shennaflu al rosho veal rubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin, mikkeli echad, mishshenayim umishshelosha, mitztarfin. mearbaa, en mitztarfin. bamme devarim amurim. bizman shehitchil hashsheni ad shello fasak harishon. uvamme devarim amurim. bizman shello nitkavven lerabbot. aval nitkavven lerabbot, afillu kortov bechol hashshana, mitztarfin lishlosha luggin: 
Hammanniach kelim tachat hatztzinnor, echad kelim gedolim veechad kelim ketannim, afillu chele gelalim, kele avanim, kele adama, poslin et hammikve. echad hammanniach veechad hashshocheach, kedivre vet shammay. uvet hillel metaharin beshocheach. amar rabbi meir, nimnu verabbu vet shammay al bet hillel. umodim beshocheach bechatzer shehu tahor. amar rabbi yose, adayin machaloket bimkomah omadet:
Mishnah Mikvaot 4:2-5:
Hammanniach tavla tachat hatztzinnor, im yesh lah levizbez, poselet et hammikve. veim lav, enah poselet et hammikve. zekafah liddoach, ben kach uven kach enah poselet et hammikve: 
Hachotet betzinnor lekabbel tzerorot, beshel etz, kol shehu. uveshel cheres, reviit. rabbi yose omer, af beshel cheres, kol shehu. lo amru reviit ella veshivre chele cheres. hayu tzerorot mitchalchalim betocho, poslim et hammikve. yarad letocho afar venichbash, kasher. sillon shehu tzar mikkan umikkan verachav min haemtza, eno fosel, mippene shello naasa lekabbala: 
Mayim sheuvin ume geshamim shennitarvu vechatzer, uvaukka, veal maalot hammeara, im rov min hakkasher, kasher. veim rov min happasul, pasul. mechetza lemechetza, pasul. ematay, bizman shemmitarvin ad shello yaggiu lammikve. hayu mekallechin betoch hammayim, im yadua shennafal letocho arbaim sea mayim kesherim, ad shello yarad letocho shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin, kasher. veim lav, pasul: 
Hashshoket shebbassela, en memallein mimmenna, veen mekaddeshin bah, veen mazzin mimmenna, veenah tzericha tzamid patil, veenah poselet et hammikve. hayta cheli vechibberah besid, memallein bah, umekaddeshin bah, umazzin mimmenna, utzericha tzamid patil, ufoselet et hammikve. nikkeva millematta o min hatztzad veenah yechola lekabbel mayim kol shehem, keshera. vechamma yihye vannekev. kishfoferet hannod. amar rabbi yehuda ben betera, maase veshoket yehu shehayta virushalayim, vehayta nekuva chishfoferet hannod, vehayu chol hattohorot shebbirushalayim naasot al gabbah, veshalchu vet shammay ufechatuha, shebbet shammay omrim, ad sheyyifchatu rubbah:
Mishnah Sukkah 1:1-3:
Sukka shehi gevoha lemala meesrim amma, pesula. rabbi yehuda machshir. vesheenah gevoha asara tefachim, vesheen lah shelosha defanot, veshechammatah merubba mitztzillatah, pesula. sukka yeshana, bet shammay poslin, uvet hillel machshirin. veezo hi sukka yeshana, kol sheasaah kodem lechag sheloshim yom. aval im asaah leshem chag, afillu mittechillat hashshana, keshera: 
Haose sukkato tachat hailan, keillu asaah betoch habbayit. sukka al gabbe sukka, haelyona cheshera, vehattachtona pesula. rabbi yehuda omer, im en diyyurin baelyona, hattachtona keshera: 
Peras aleha sadin mippene hachamma, o tachteha mippene hanneshar, o shepperas al gabbe hakkinof, pesula. aval pores hu al gabbe naklite hammitta:
Mishnah Sukkah 1:4-7:
Hidla aleha et haggefen veet haddelaat veet hakkissom vesikkech al gabbah, pesula. veim haya sikkuch harebe mehen, o shekketzatzan, keshera. ze hakkelal, kol shehu mekabbel tuma veen giddulo min haaretz, en mesakkechin bo. vechol davar sheeno mekabbel tuma vegiddulo min haaretz, mesakkechin bo: 
Chavile kash vachavile etzim vachavile zeradin, en mesakkechin bahen. vechullan shehittiran, kesherot. vechullan kesherot laddefanot: 
Mesakkechin binsarim, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi meir oser. natan aleha neser shehu rachav arbaa tefachim, keshera, uvilvad shelo yishan tachtav: 
Tikra sheen aleha maaziva, rabbi yehuda omer, bet shammay omrim, mefakpek venotel achat mibbentayim, uvet hillel omrim, mefakpek o notel achat mibbentayim. rabbi meir omer, notel achat mibbentayim, veen mefakpek:
Mishnah Sukkah 1:8-2:1:
Hamekare sukkato veshappudin o vaarukkot hammitta, im yesh revach benehen kemotan, keshera. hachotet begadish laasot bo sukka, enah sukka: 
Hameshalshel defanot milmala lematta, im gavoah min haaretz shelosha tefachim, pesula. millematta lemala, im gavoah min haaretz asara tefachim, keshera. rabbi yose omer, keshem shemmillematta lemala asara tefachim, kach milmala lematta asara tefachim. hirchik et hassikkuch min haddefanot shelosha tefachim, pesula: 
Bayit shennifchat vesikkech al gabbav, im yesh min hakkotel lassikkuch arba ammot, pesula. vechen chatzer shehi mukkefet achsadra. sukka gedola, shehikkifuha vedavar sheen mesakkechim bo, im yesh tachtav arba ammot, pesula: 
Haose sukkato kemin tzerif, o shessemachah lechotel, rabbi eliezer posel, mippene sheen lah gag, vachachamim machshirin. machtzelet kanim gedola, asaah lishchiva, mekabbelet tuma veen mesakkechin bah. lesikkuch, mesakkechin bah veenah mekabbelet tuma. rabbi eliezer omer, achat ketanna veachat gedola, asaah lishchiva, mekabbelet tuma veen mesakkechin bah. lesikkuch, mesakkechin bah veenah mekabbelet tuma: 
Hayyashen tachat hammitta vassukka, lo yatza yede chovato. amar rabbi yehuda, nohagin hayinu, shehayinu yeshenim tachat hammitta bifne hazzekenim, velo amru lanu davar. amar rabbi shimon, maase vetavi avdo shel rabban gamliel shehaya yashen tachat hammitta, veamar lahen rabban gamliel lazzekenim, reitem tavi avdi, shehu talmid chacham veyodea sheavadim peturin min hassukka, lefichach yashen hu tachat hammitta. ulefi darkenu lamadnu, shehayyashen tachat hammitta, lo yatza yede chovato:
Mishnah Sukkah 2:2-5:
Hassomech sukkato bechare hammitta, keshera. rabbi yehuda omer, im enah yechola laamod bifne atzmah, pesula. sukka hameduvlelet, veshetztzillatah merubba mechammatah, keshera. hameubba chemin bayit, af al pi sheen hakkochavim nirim mittochah, keshera: 
Haose sukkato berosh haagala o berosh hassefina, keshera, veolin lah beyom tov. berosh hailan o al gabbe gamal, keshera, veen olin lah beyom tov. shetayim bailan veachat bide adam, o shetayim bide adam veachat bailan, keshera, veen olin lah beyom tov. shalosh bide adam veachat bailan, keshera, veolin lah beyom tov. ze hakkelal, kol shennittal hailan vichola laamod bifne atzmah, keshera, veolin lah beyom tov: 
Haose sukkato ben hailanot, vehailanot defanot lah, keshera. sheluche mitzva peturin min hassukka. cholin umeshammeshehen peturin min hassukka. ochlin veshotin aray chutz lassukka: 
Maase veheviu lo lerabban yochanan ben zakkay litom et hattavshil, ulerabban gamliel shete chotavot udeli shel mayim, veamru, haalum lassukka. ucheshennatnu lo lerabbi tzadok ochel pachot mikkabbetza, netalo vammappa vaachalo chutz lassukka, velo verach acharav:
Mishnah Sukkah 2:6-9:
Rabbi eliezer omer, arba esre seudot chayyav adam leechol bassukka, achat bayyom veachat ballayla. vachachamim omrim, en laddavar kitzva, chutz millele yom tov rishon shel chag bilvad. veod amar rabbi eliezer, mi shello achal lele yom tov harishon, yashlim belele yom tov haacharon. vachachamim omrim, en laddavar tashlumin, al ze neemar (Kohelet 1) meuvvat lo yuchal litkon, vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot: 
Mi shehaya rosho verubbo vassukka, veshulchano vetoch habbayit, bet shammay poslin, uvet hillel machshirin. amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay, lo chach haya maase, shehalchu zikne vet shammay vezikne vet hillel levakker et rabbi yochanan ben hachorani, umetzauhu shehaya yoshev rosho verubbo vassukka, veshulchano vetoch habbayit, velo amru lo davar. amru lahen bet shammay, mishsham reaya, af hem amru lo, im ken hayita noheg, lo kiyyamta mitzvat sukka miyyamecha: 
Nashim vaavadim uketannim, peturim min hassukka. katan sheeno tzarich leimmo, chayyav bassukka. maase veyalda challato shel shammay hazzaken ufichet et hammaaziva vesikkech al gabbe hammitta bishvil hakkatan: 
Kol shivat hayyamim adam ose sukkato keva uveto aray. yardu geshamim, meematay muttar lefannot, mishshettisrach hammikpa. mashlu mashal, lema haddavar dome, leeved shebba limzog kos lerabbo, veshafach lo kiton al panav:
Mishnah Yoma 8:4-8:
Hattinokot, en meannin otan beyom hakkippurim, aval mechannechin otam lifne shana velifne shenatayim, bishvil sheyyihyu regilin bammitzvot: 
Ubbara shehericha, maachilin otah ad shettashiv nafshah. chole maachilin oto al pi vekiin. veim en sham bekiin, maachilin oto al pi atzmo, ad sheyyomar day: 
Mi sheachazo vulmus, maachilin oto afillu devarim temeim, ad sheyyeoru enav. mi shenneshacho chelev shote, en maachilin oto mechatzar kaved shelo, verabbi matya ven charash mattir. veod amar rabbi matya ven charash, hachoshesh bigrono, mattilin lo sam betoch piv beshabbat, mippene shehu sefek nefashot, vechol sefek nefashot doche et hashshabbat: 
Mi shennafla alav mappolet, safek hu sham safek eno sham, safek chay safek met, safek nachri safek yisrael, mefakkechin alav et haggal. metzauhu chay, mefakkechin alav. veim met, yannichuhu: 
Chattat veasham vadday mechapperin. mita veyom hakkippurim mechapperin im hatteshuva. hatteshuva mechapperet al averot kallot al ase veal lo taase. veal hachamurot hi tola ad sheyyavo yom hakkippurim vichapper:
Mishnah Yoma 8:9: Haomer, echeta veashuv, echeta veashuv, en maspikin beyado laasot teshuva. echeta veyom hakkippurim mechapper, en yom hakkippurim mechapper. averot shebben adam lammakom, yom hakkippurim mechapper. averot shebben adam lachavero, en yom hakkippurim mechapper, ad sheyyeratztze et chavero. et zo darash rabbi elazar ben azarya, mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu (Vayikra 16), averot shebben adam lammakom, yom hakkippurim mechapper. averot shebben adam lachavero, en yom hakkippurim mechapper, ad sheyyeratztze et chavero. amar rabbi akiva, ashrechem yisrael, lifne mi attem mittaharin, umi metaher etchem, avichem shebbashshamayim, shenneemar (yechezkel lo), vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim utehartem. veomer (yirmeya 17), mikve yisrael Adonai, ma mikve metaher et hattemeim, af hakkadosh baruch hu metaher et yisrael:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: En hakkore rashshay lehagebiah kolo yoter min hametargem. vehametargem lo yagbiah kolo yoter min hakkore. veen hametargem rashshay letargem ad sheyyichle happasuk mippi hakkore. veen hakkore rashshay likrot pasuk acher ad sheyyichle hattargum mippi hatturgeman. veen hatturgeman nishan lo leammud velo lekora ella omed beema uveyira. velo yetargem mittoch hakketav ella al pe. veen hakkore rashshay lesayyea latturgeman shello yomru targum katuv battora. vehakkatan metargem al yede gadol veen kavod laggadol sheyyetargem al yede katan. velo yihyu hametargemin shenayim keechad ella echad kore veechad metargem:

Velo kol hammikraot metargeminan betzibbur. <small>(Bereshit la 22)</small> "maase reuven" u<small>(Bamidbar 6 22 27)</small> "virkat kohanim" umaase haegel min <small>(Shemot 32 21)</small> "vayyomer moshe el aharon" ad <small>(Shemot 32 25)</small> "vayyar moshe et haam" vegomer veod pasuk echad <small>(Shemot 32 la)</small> "vayyiggof Adonai et haam" kullam nikrain velo mittargemin. uvemaase amnon bammakom shenneemar <small>(Shmuel b 13 1)</small> "amnon ben david" nikra velo mittargem:

Hammaftir bannavi tzarich likrot battora techilla afillu shelosha pesukim. chozer vekore ma shekkara lefanav. velo yaftir bannavi ad sheyyiglol sefer tora. velo yifchot meesrim veechad pesukim. veim shalem hainyan befachot meellu eno tzarich lehosif. veim kara asara pesukim vetirgeman hametargem dayyo vaafillu lo shalem hainyan. uvannavi echad kore vaafillu shenayim metargemin. umedalleg meinyan leinyan acher. veeno medalleg minnavi lenavi ella binviim shel shenem asar bilvad. uvilvad shello yedalleg missof hassefer litchillato. vechol hamedalleg lo yishhe bedillug ella kede sheyyashlim hametargem targumo:

Hakkore bannavi yesh lo likrot latturgeman shelosha pesukim vehametargem metargem shelashtan ze achar ze. veim hayu shelosha happesukim shalosh parashiyyot lo yikra latturgeman ella echad echad bilvad:

Hammaftir bannavi mevarech lefanav beracha achat. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bachar binviim vechulei. umevarech leacharav arba berachot. beracha rishona chotem bah hael hanneeman bechol devarav. sheniyya chotem bah bone yerushalayim. shelishit chotem bah magen david. reviit chotem bah inyan kedushshat hayyom kemo shechotem battefilla. vechen im chal rosh chodesh lihyot beshabbat hammaftir bannavi mazkir rosh chodesh bivracha zo kemo shemmazkir battefilla:

Kamma hen hakkorin. beshabbat beshacharit korin shiva. uveyom hakkippurim shishsha. uveyamim tovim chamishsha. en pochatin mehen aval mosifin alehem. berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed korin arbaa. beshabbat uveyom hakkippurim bemincha uvesheni uvachamishi shel kol hashshana uvachanukka uvefurim beshacharit uvime hattaanit beshacharit uvemincha korin shelosha. en pochatin mimminyan ze veen mosifin alehen:

En hakkore rashshay likrot ad sheyyomar lo gadol shebbatztzibbur likrot. vaafillu chazzan hakkeneset o rosh hakkeneset eno kore meatzmo ad sheyyomru lo hatztzibbur o gadol shebbahem likrot. vetzarich echad laamod immo bishat keria kederech chazzan haomed im hakkorin:

Hakkore yesh lo ledalleg mimmakom lemakom beinyan echad kegon <small>(Vayikra 16 1)</small> "achare mot" v<small>(Vayikra 23 27)</small> "ach beasor" shebbefarashat <small>(Vayikra 21 1)</small> "emor el hakkohanim". vehu shello yikra al pe sheasur likrot shello min hakketav afillu teva achat. velo yishhe bedillug ella kede sheyyashlim hatturgeman targum happasuk:

Kevan shehitchil hakkore likrot battora asur lesapper afillu bidvar halacha ella hakkol shomin veshotkin umesimin libbam lema shehu kore shenneemar <small>(nechemya 8 3)</small> "veazne chol haam el sefer hattora". veasur latzet min hakkeneset beshaa shehakkore kore. umuttar latzet ben ish leish. umi shehu osek battora tamid vetorato umnuto muttar lo laasok betalmud tora beshaa shehakkore kore battora:

Mimot ezra nahagu sheyyehe sham turgeman metargem laam ma shehakkore kore battora kede sheyyavinu inyan haddevarim. vehakkore kore pasuk echad bilvad veshotek ad sheyyetargem oto hatturgeman vechozer vekore pasuk sheni. veen hakkore rashshay likrot lamturgeman yoter mippasuk echad:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 9:18-20:
Hammesech chayyav vehi melacha meavot melachot. vehashshovet al hachutin ad sheyyipparku vitakkenem hare ze toledet mesech. vechamma shiuro mishsheyyetakken rochav shete etzbaot. vechen haoreg shene chutin berochav shete etzbaot chayyav. ben shearagan battechilla ben shehaya miktzat habbeged arug vearag al haarug shiuro shene chutin. veim arag chut echad vehishlim bo habbeged chayyav. arag bisfat hayeria shene chutin berochav shelosha batte nirin chayyav. ha lema ze dome leoreg tziltzul katan berochav shelosha batte nirin: 
Hamedakdek et hachutin umafridan beet haariga hare ze toledet oreg. vechen hakkolea et hannimin hare ze toledet oreg veshiuro mishsheyyaase kelia beorech shete etzbaot: 
Habbotzea shene chutin chayyav. uvotzea hu hammafrish et haarug. ben shehotzi haerev min hashsheti o sheheevir hashsheti meal haerev hare ze botzea vechayyav. vehu shello yehe mekalkel ella yitkavven letakken kederech sheosin ellu shemmeachin et habbegadim hakkallim beyoter shebbotzin veachar kach meachin vechozrin veorgin chutin shebbatzu ad sheyyeasu shene habbegadim o shene hakkeraim echad. vehassoter et hakkelia letakken hare ze toledet botzea veshiuro keshiur habbotzea:
Niddah 24a:6-9: Ittemar: hammappelet mi sheppanav musemasim, rabbi yochanan amar: immo temea, resh lakish amar: immo tehora.

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: hammappelet yad chatucha veregel chatucha — immo temea leda, veen choshshin shemma migguf atum bata. veim ita, litne: shemma migguf atum o mimmi sheppanav musemasin!
Amar rav pappe: befanav musemasin — kulle alma la peligi ditmea, ki peligi — befanav tuchot, veippecha ittemar: rabbi yochanan amar immo tehora, veresh lakish amar immo temea.
Velotveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan meha! mishshum deshanni leh: hayeynu guf atum, hayeynu mi sheppanav tuchot.
Pesachim 106a:5-106b:1: Tanu rabbanan: "zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho" — zochrehu al hayyayin. en li ella beyom, ballayla minnayin? talmud lomar: "zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho".

"Ballayla minnayin"?! adderabba, ikkar kiddusha ballayla hu kadesh, dechi kadesh — techillat yoma bae lekaydoshe! vetu: "ballayla minnayin talmud lomar: zachor et yom", tanna meyhaddar allayla veka nasev leh kera dimama?!
Hachi kaamar: "zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho" — zochrehu al hayyayin bichnisato, en li ella ballayla, bayyom minnayin? talmud lomar: "zachor et yom hashshabbat".
Beyom may mevarech? amar rav yehuda: "bore peri haggefen". rav ashe ikkela lemachoza, amaru leh: likaddesh lan mar kiddusha rabba (havu leh).

Sevar: may nihu "kiddusha rabba"? amar, mikkede kol habberachot kullan "bore peri haggefen" amri beresha, amar "bore peri haggefen" veagged beh. chazyeh lehahu sava degachen veshate, kare annafsheh "hechacham enav berosho".
Amri bene rabbi chiyyay: mi shello hivdil bemotzae shabbat — mavdil veholech bechol hashshabbat kullo. vead kamma? amar rabbi zera: ad revii beshabbat.

Ki ha deyatev rabbi zera kammeh derav assi, veamri la rav assi kammeh derabbi yochanan, veyatev vekaamar: leinyan gittin, chada beshabbeta tere utelata — batar shabbeta. arba vechamsha umaale yoma — kamme shabbeta.
Amar rabbi yaakov bar idi: aval lo al haur.

Hannotel yadav lo yekaddesh. amar lehu rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta: akkatti la nach nafsheh derav shechachninhu lishmateteh. zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh derav, zimnin dachaviva aleh rifta — mekaddesh arifta. zimnin dachaviva leh chamra — mekaddesh achamra.
Pirkei Avot 1:14-17:
Hu haya omer, im en ani li, mi li. uchesheani leatzmi, ma ani. veim lo achshav, ematay: 
Shammay omer, ase toratcha keva. emor meat vaase harebe, veheve mekabbel et kol haadam besever panim yafot: 
Rabban gamliel haya omer, ase lecha rav, vehistallek min hassafek, veal tarbe leasser omadot: 
Shimon beno omer, kol yamay gadalti ven hachachamim, velo matzati lagguf tov ella shetika. velo hammidrash hu haikkar, ella hammaase. vechol hammarbe devarim, mevi chet:
Pirkei Avot 1:18-2:3: Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, al shelosha devarim haolam omed, al haddin veal haemet veal hashshalom, shenneemar (zecharya 8) emet umishpat shalom shiftu beshaarechem:

Rabbi omer, ezohi derech yeshara sheyyavor lo haadam, kol shehi tiferet leoseha vetiferet lo min haadam. veheve zahir bemitzva kalla chevachamura, sheen atta yodea mattan secharan shel mitzvot. veheve mechashshev hefsed mitzva keneged secharah, usechar avera cheneged hefsedah. vehistakkel bishlosha devarim vei atta va lide avera, da ma lemala mimmecha, ayin roa veozen shomaat, vechol maasecha vassefer nichtavin:

Rabban gamliel beno shel rabbi yehuda hannasi omer, yafe talmud tora im derech eretz, sheyyegiat shenehem meshakkachat avon. vechol tora sheen immah melacha, sofah betela vegoreret avon. vechol haamelim im hatztzibbur, yihyu amelim immahem leshem shamayim, shezzechut avotam mesayyatan vetzidkatam omedet laad. veattem, maale ani alechem sachar harebe keillu asitem:
Hevu zehirin barashut, sheen mekarvin lo laadam ella letzorech atzman. nirin keohavin bishat hanaatan, veen omdin lo laadam bishat dachko:
Pirkei Avot 2:13-16: Rabbi shimon omer, heve zahir bikriat shema uvattefilla. uchesheatta mitpallel, al taas tefillatcha keva, ella rachamim vetachanunim lifne hammakom baruch hu, shenneemar (Yoel b) ki channun verachum hu erech appayim verav chesed venicham al haraa. veal tehi rasha bifne atzmecha:
Rabbi elazar omer, heve shakud lilmod tora, veda ma shettashiv leeppikoros. veda lifne mi atta amel. veneeman hu vaal melachtecha sheyyeshallem lach sechar peullatech:
Rabbi tarfon omer, hayyom katzar vehammelacha merubba, vehappoalim atzelim, vehassachar harebe, uvaal habbayit dochek:

Hu haya omer, lo alecha hammelacha ligmor, velo atta ven chorin libbatel mimmenna. im lamadta tora harebe, notnim lecha sachar harebe. veneeman hu vaal melachtecha sheyyeshallem lecha sechar peullatecha. veda mattan secharan shel tzaddikim leatid lavo:
Pirkei Avot 2:4-8: Hu haya omer, ase retzono chirtzoncha, kede sheyyaase retzoncha chirtzono. battel retzoncha mippene retzono, kede sheyyevattel retzon acherim mippene retzonecha. hillel omer, al tifrosh min hatztzibbur, veal taamin beatzmecha ad yom motcha, veal tadin et chavercha ad shettaggia limkomo, veal tomar davar shei efshar lishmoa, shessofo lehishshama. veal tomar lichsheippane eshne, shemma lo tippane:
Hu haya omer, en bur yere chet, velo am haaretz chasid, velo habbayshan lamed, velo hakkappedan melammed, velo chol hammarbe vischora machkim. uvemakom sheen anashim, hishtaddel lihyot ish:
Af hu raa gulgolet achat shetztzafa al pene hammayim. amar lah, al daateft, atfuch. vesof metifayich yetufun:

Hu haya omer, marbe vasar, marbe rimma. marbe nechasim, marbe deaga. marbe nashim, marbe cheshafim. marbe shefachot, marbe zimma. marbe avadim, marbe gazel. marbe tora, marbe chayyim. marbe yeshiva, marbe chachma. marbe etza, marbe tevuna. marbe tzedaka, marbe shalom. kana shem tov, kana leatzmo. kana lo divre tora, kana lo chayye haolam habba:

Rabban yochanan ben zakkay kibbel mehillel umishshammay. hu haya omer, im lamadta tora harebe, al tachazik tova leatzmecha, ki lechach notzarta. chamishsha talmidim hayu lo lerabban yochanan ben zakkay, veellu hen, rabbi eliezer ben horkenos, verabbi yehoshua ben chananya, verabbi yose hakkohen, verabbi shimon ben netanel, verabbi elazar ben arach. hu haya mone shivchan. rabbi eliezer ben horkenos, bor sud sheeno meabbed tippa. rabbi yehoshua ben chananya, ashre yoladto. rabbi yose hakkohen, chasid. rabbi shimon ben netanel, yere chet. verabbi elazar ben arach, mayan hammitgabber. hu haya omer, im yihyu chol chachme yisrael bechaf moznayim, veeliezer ben horkenos bechaf sheniyya, machria et kullam. abba shaul omer mishshemo, im yihyu chol chachme yisrael bechaf moznayim verabbi eliezer ben horkenos af immahem, verabbi elazar ben arach bechaf sheniyya, machria et kullam:
Pirkei Avot 2:9-12: Amar lahem, tzeu ureu ezohi derech yeshara sheyyidbak bah haadam. rabbi eliezer omer, ayin tova. rabbi yehoshua omer, chaver tov. rabbi yose omer, shachen tov. rabbi shimon omer, haroe et hannolad. rabbi elazar omer, lev tov. amar lahem, roe ani et divre elazar ben arach middivrechem, shebbichlal devarav divrechem. amar lahem tzeu ureu ezohi derech raa sheyyitrachek mimmenna haadam. rabbi eliezer omer, ayin raa. rabbi yehoshua omer, chaver ra. rabbi yose omer, shachen ra. rabbi shimon omer, hallove veeno meshallem. echad hallove min haadam, kelove min hammakom baruch hu, shenneemar (tehillim 37) love rasha velo yeshallem, vetzaddik chonen venoten. rabbi elazar omer, lev ra. amar lahem, roe ani et divre elazar ben arach middivrechem, shebbichlal devarav divrechem:

Hem amru shelosha devarim. rabbi eliezer omer, yehi chevod chavercha chaviv alecha keshellach, veal tehi noach lichos. veshuv yom echad lifne mitatcha. veheve mitchammem keneged uran shel chachamim, veheve zahir begachaltan shello tikkave, shenneshichatan neshichat shual, vaakitzatan akitzat akrav, ulechishatan lechishat saraf, vechol divrehem kegachale esh:
Rabbi yehoshua omer, ayin hara, veyetzer hara, vesinat habberiyyot, motziin et haadam min haolam:
Rabbi yose omer, yehi mamon chavercha chaviv alecha keshellach, vehateken atzmecha lilmod tora, sheenah yerushsha lach. vechol maasecha yihyu leshem shamayim:
Pirkei Avot 3:1-5: Akavya ven mahalalel omer, histakkel bishlosha devarim vei atta va lide avera. da meayin bata, ulean atta holech, velifne mi atta atid litten din vecheshbon. meayin bata, mittippa serucha, ulean atta holech, limkom afar rimma vetolea. velifne mi atta atid litten din vecheshbon, lifne melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu:

Rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer, heve mitpallel bishlomah shel malchut, sheilmale moraah, ish et reehu chayyim belao. rabbi chanina ven teradyon omer, shenayim sheyyoshvin veen benehen divre tora, hare ze moshav letzim, shenneemar (tehillim 1) uvemoshav letzim lo yashav. aval shenayim sheyyoshvin veyesh benehem divre tora, shechina sheruya venehem, shenneemar (Malachi 3) az nidberu yire Adonai ish el reehu vayyakshev Adonai vayyishma vayyikkatev sefer zikkaron lefanav leyire Adonai ulechoshve shemo. en li ella shenayim, minnayin sheafillu echad sheyyoshev veosek battora, shehakkadosh baruch hu kovea lo sachar, shenneemar (Eicha 3) yeshev badad veyiddom ki natal alav:

Rabbi shimon omer, shelosha sheachlu al shulchan echad velo amru alav divre tora, keillu achlu mizzivche metim, shenneemar (yeshaya koach) ki kol shulchanot malu ki tzoa beli makom. aval shelosha sheachlu al shulchan echad veamru alav divre tora, keillu achlu mishshulchano shel makom baruch hu, shenneemar (yechezkel ma) vaydabber elay ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai:
Rabbi chanina ven chachinay omer, hanneor ballayla vehamehallech badderech yechidi vehamefanne libbo levattala, hare ze mitchayyev benafsho:
Rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana omer, kol hamekabbel alav ol tora, maavirin mimmennu ol malchut veol derech eretz. vechol happorek mimmennu ol tora, notnin alav ol malchut veol derech eretz:

Sotah 3b:11-4b:7: Amar rav chisda: zenuta beveta ki karya leshumeshma. veamar rav chisda: tukepa beveta ki karya leshumeshma. idde veidde beitteta, aval begavra let lan ba.

Veamar rav chisda: battechilla, kodem shechatu yisrael, hayta shechina shora im kol echad veechad, shenneemar: "ki Adonai elohecha mithallech bekerev machanecha". kevan shechatu nistalleka shechina mehem, shenneemar: "velo yire vecha ervat davar veshav meacharecha".

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol haose mitzva achat baolam hazze — mekaddamto veholechet lefanav laolam habba, shenneemar: "vehalach lefanecha tzidkecha". vechol haover avera achat baolam hazze — melappafto veholechet lefanav leyom haddin, shenneemar: "yillaftu orchot darkam yaalu vattohu veyovedu".
Rabbi elazar omer: keshura bo kechelev, shenneemar: "velo shama eleha lishkav etzlah lihyot immah". "lishkav etzlah" — baolam hazze, "lihyot immah" — laolam habba.
Tenan hatam, shehaya baddin:
Uma edut harishona, sheen osartah issur olam — enah mitkayyemet befachot mishshenayim, edut haacharona, sheosartah issur olam — eno din shello titkayyem befachot mishshenayim?
Talmud lomar: "veed en bah", kol sheyyesh bah.
Vekal vachomer leedut harishona meatta: uma edut haacharona, sheosartah issur olam — mitkayyemet beed echad, edut harishona, sheen osartah issur olam — eno din shettitkayyem beed echad?
Talmud lomar: "ki matza vah ervat davar", ulehallan hu omer "al pi shene edim o al pi shelosha edim yakum davar". ma "davar" haamur lehallan — al pi shenayim edim, af kan — al pi shenayim.
Hay mikki matza vah ervat davar" nafka? mibbah" nafka: bah — velo bekinnuy, bah — velo bistira mibbee leh!
Hachi name kaamar: talmud lomar "bah": bah — velo bekinnuy, bah — velo bistira.

Vetumea bealma belo kinnuy uvelo setira, dela meheman ed echad, menalan? neemar kan: "ki matza vah ervat davar", veneemar lehallan: "al pi shene edim o al pi shelosha edim yakum davar". ma "davar" haamur lehallan — edim shenayim, af kan — edim shenayim.
Tanu rabbanan: e zo hi edut harishona — zo edut setira, edut acharona — zo edut tumea.
Vechamma shiur setira? kede tumea, kede via, kede haaraa.
Kede hakkafat dekel, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi eliezer omer: kede mezigat hakkos. rabbi yehoshua omer: kede lishtoto.
Ben azzay omer: kede litzlot betza. rabbi akiva omer: kede legomah. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: kede ligmoa shalosh betzim zo achar zo. rabbi elazar ben yirmeya omer: kede likshor gardi nima.

Chanin ben pinchas omer: kede shettoshit yadah letoch piha littol kesam. pelemo omer: kede shettoshit yadah lassal littol kikkar. af al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar: "ki vead ishsha zona ad kikkar lachem".
Vechol hane lema li?
Tzerichi, dei tena kede tumea, hava amena: kede tumeatah veartzutah, ka mashma lan kede via.
Vei tena kede via, hava amena: kede gemar bia, ka mashma lan kede haaraa.
Vei ashmeinan kede haaraa, hava amena: kede haaraa veartzutah, ka mashma lan kede tumea. vechamma kede [haaraa] — kede hakkafat dekel.
Ureminhi "venistera", vechamma shiur setira lo shamanu. keshehu omer "vehi nitmaa", heve omer — kede tumea, kede via, kede haaraa, kede chazarat dekel, divre rabbi eliezer.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: kede mezigat hakkos. ben azzay omer: kede lishtoto. rabbi akiva omer: kede litzlot betza. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: kede legomah.
Ka salka datin: hayeynu hakkafat dekel, hayeynu chazarat dekel. hatam amar rabbi yishmael: kede hakkafat dekel, ufelig rabbi eliezer aleh. hacha amar rabbi eliezer kede chazarat dekel!
Amar abbaye: hakkafa baregel, chazara baruach.
Bae rav ashe: chazara baruach ki hechi deazel vahadar ate, o dilma ki hechi deazel veate vahadar kae beducheteh. teku.
Hatam amar rabbi eliezer: kede mezigat hakkos, hacha: kede chazarat dekel! idde veidde chad shiura hu.
Hatam amar rabbi yehoshua: kede lishtoto, hacha amar: kede mezigat hakkos! ema kede limzog velishtot. velema: idde veidde chad shiura hu! im ken, hayeynu rabbi eliezer.
Hatam amar ben azzay: kede litzlot betza, hacha amar: kede lishtoto. idde veidde chad shiura hu.
Hatam amar rabbi akiva: kede legomah, hacha amar: kede litzlot betza! ema kede litzlot betza ulegomah. velema: idde veidde chad shiura hu! im ken, hayeynu ben azzay.

Hatam amar rabbi yehuda ben betera: kede ligmoa shalosh betzim zo achar zo, hacha amar: kede legomah! lidvarav derabbi akiva kaamar, dekaamar meshaarin bitzlia uvigmia: ema shiur gemia lechoda kede ligmoa shalosh betzim zo achar zo, dehayynu tzelia ugemia.
Rabbi elazar ben yirmeya omer: kede sheyyikshor gardi nima. bae rav ashe: dimrachak, o dimkarav? teku.
Chanin ben pinchas omer: kede shettoshit yadah letoch piha littol kesam. bae rav ashe: dimhaddak o dela mehaddak? teku.
Pelemo omer: kede shettoshit yadah lassal littol kikkar. bae rav ashe: dimhaddak o dela mehaddak? bechadta o beattika? bechammima o bekarira?
Bidchitte o bedisare? berakkicha o baakosha? teku.
Amar rav yitzchak bar rav yosef amar rabbi yochanan: kol echad veechad — beatzmo shier. vehaikka ben azzay dela nesev?
Ibbaet ema: nesev uferash hava. veibbaet ema: merabbeh shemia leh. veibbaet ema: "sod Adonai lireav".

Daresh rav avvira, zimnin amar la mishshemeh derabbi amme, vezimnin amar la mishshemeh derabbi assi: kol haochel lechem belo netilat yadayim — keillu ba al ishsha zona. shenneemar: "ki vead ishsha zona ad kikkar lachem".
Amar rava: hay "bead ishsha zona ad kikkar lachem" — "bead kikkar lechem ad ishsha zona" mibbee leh! ella amar rava: kol habba al ishsha zona, lesof mevakkesh kikkar lechem.

Amar rabbi zerika amar rabbi elazar: kol hammezalzel bintilat yadayim neekar min haolam. amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: mayim rishonim — tzarich sheyyagbiah yadav lemala, mayim acharonim — tzarich sheyyashpil yadav lematta. tanya name hachi: hannotel yadav — tzarich sheyyagbiah yadav lemala, shemma yetzu hammayim chutz lapperek, veyachzeru vitammeu et hayyadayim.
Amar rabbi avahu: kol haochel pat belo nigguv yadayim — keillu ochel lechem tame, shenneemar: "vayyomer Adonai kacha yochlu vene yisrael et lachmam tame vegomer".
Zohar, Beshalach 17: (Shemot 15:3) Adonai ish milchama Adonai shemo. ribbi abba patach (Bamidbar 21:14) al ken yeamar besefer milchamot Adonai et vahev besufa veet hannechalim arnon. kama it lan leistakkela befitgame orayyta, kama it lan leayyeyna bechol millaha, delet lach milla beorayyta, dela itremiza bishma kaddisha illaa, velet lach milla beorayyta, delet bah kamma razin, kamma taamin, kamma sharashin, kamma anafin.

Hacha it leistakkela, al ken yeamar besefer milchamot Adonai, vechi sefer milchamot Adonai, an hu. ella hachi ittearu chavrayyay, kol man deaggach kerava beorayyta, zache leasgaa shelama besof milloy. kol keravin dealma, ketata vechurbana. vechol keravin deorayyta, shelama urechimuta, hada hu dichtiv al ken yeamar besefer milchamot Adonai et vahev besufa, kelomar, ahava besufa. delet lach ahava ushelama bar mehay.

Tu kashya beatreh. al ken yeamar besefer milchamot Adonai, betorat milchamot Adonai mibbae leh, may besefer. ella raza illaa hu, atar it leh lekudesha berich hu, deikre sefer (nusach acher umispar) kema deat amer, (yeshaya la) dirshu meal sefer Adonai ukerau. dechol chelin ugevuran deavid kudesha berich hu, behahu sefer talyayn, (nusach acher umittamman nafkin

Et vahev besofah. man vahev, ella kol inun chelin, vechol inun gevuran deavid kudesha berich hu, behahu sefer talyayn.) vechad aggach kudesha berich hu keravoy, bechad atar deihu besofa dedargin, veikre vahev. kema deat amer (Mishlei 30:15) laaluka shete banot hav hav. besufa: besof dargin ishtechach. besufa: yam sof itkere, yam deihu sof lechol dargin.

Veet hannechalim arnon veim nachlayay deishtachchu veatnegidu. legabbe, mehahu atar illaa, deikre arnon. may arnon, ziuuga illaa dachavivuta, dela (50 amud bet) mitparshan lealmin, kema deat amer (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden. uveda, mishtarshan sharashoy, veitreviu anafav, leoshata keravoy bechol atar, leoshata chelin ugevuran, uleitchazaa shuletana rabba veyakkira decholla.

Ta chaze, kad mitarin gevuran ukeravin dekudesha berich hu, kamma gardine tehirin, mitarin lechol ivar, keden shannenan rumechin, vesayyfin, umitarin gevuran, veyamma itregishat vegalgalloy sallekin venachtin, vearvin deazlin veshatan beyamma, lechol ivar mistallekin. shinnana kerava (nusach acher charba) beavni ballisteraot, mare deromchin vesayyfin, keden (Tehillim 45:6) chitztzecha shenunim (nusach acher mitarin leoshata kerevin bechol atar valeaveshatea chelin ugevuran lechol ivar keden yamma itregishat vegalgalloy sallekin vearvin deazlin veshatin nachtin vesallekin vazeapea ishtechach. keden mitarin maggiche kerava beavne balesateraayn mare deromchin vesayyfin girin vekashtin kema deat amar chitztzecha shenunim) vekudesha berich hu ittakif becheloy, uleitara kerava. vavy leinun demalka kaddisha yitar alayyhu kerava. keden ketiv, Adonai ish milchama.

Umehacha, umeinnun atvavn, umehay kera, nafkin ture kerava leinun chayyayvayya, leillen mare devavu dechavu lekudesha berich hu. veatvavn itgalleyayn leinun mare keshot, veha itparshan millin veha ittemar.

Adonai ish milchama Adonai shemo. kevan dichtiv Adonai ish milchama, la yedana daAdonai shemo. ella, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 19:24) vaAdonai himtir al sedom veal amora gafrit vaesh meet Adonai min hashshamayim. vecholla behay sefer talyayn, kema deat amer (iyyov 20:27) yegallu shamayim avono veeretz mitkomama lo. Zohar, Beshalach 22: (Shemot 15:9) amar oyev erdof assig achallek shalal. amar oyev, da hahu memana ravreva al mitzrae, beshaata deityehiv leh shultanuta al yisrael, chashiv deyeshetzinun techot shultaneh. ella dedachar kudesha berich hu ture alma, dahavo meginnin alayyhu. vela tema da bilchodoy, ella kol innun ravrevin dimmanan al kol ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, vechad ityeyhiv lehu reshuta veshultanuta al yisrael, kullehu baan dishetzun yisrael techotayyhu.

Veal da, innun ammin ditchot shuletanehon deinnun memanan, kullehu gazyrin gezirin leshetzaa lon, ella dekudesha berich hu dechar ture alma, veagin alayyhu. vechad chama moshe da, shara leshabbecha lekudesha berich hu, veamar mi chamocha baelim Adonai.
Zohar, Shemot 2: Ribbi shimon patach, (yechezkel 1) hayo haya devar Adonai, hayo haya tere zimni amay. vetu it leshaala, i yechezkel nevia mehemana hava, (Shemot 82 2) amay galle kol ma dechama, man demalka ail leh behechaleh it leh legalaa razin dechame. ella vadday yechezkel nevia mehemana hava, vechol ma dechama bimhemanuta ihu, uvirshuta dekudesha berich hu galle kol ma degalle, vecholla itzterich.

Amar rabbi shimon, man deragil lemisbal tzaara af al gav deate lefum shata tzaara, savil matlanoy, vela chayish, aval man dela ragil betztzaar, vahava kol yomoy betafnukin veidunin, veate leh tzaara, da ihu tzaara shelim, veal da itzterich lemivke.

Kacha yisrael, kad nachtu lemitzrayim, regilin betzaara havo, deha kol yomoy dehahu zakkaa avuhon betzaara hava, veal da savlu galuta kedka yaut. aval galuta devavel hahu hava tzaara shelim, hahu hava tzaara deillain vetattain bachan aleh.

Illain: dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:7) hen erellam tzaaku chutza vegomer. tattain: dichtiv, (Tehillim 137:1) al naharot bavel sham yashavnu vegomer kullehon bachu al galuta devavel. may tama. begin dahavo betafnuke malchin dichtiv, (Eicha 4:2) bene tziyyon hayekarim vegomer.

(8 Ditnan amar rabbi yitzchak, may dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 9:9) al heharim eshsha bechi unehe. ella, illen inun turaya ramya dealmin. uman inun turaya ramya, inun, bene tziyyon hayekarim hamesavelaaym bappaz) vehashsheta havo nachtin begaluta, berechayya al kadlehon videhon mehaddekan laachora. vechad alu begaluta bevavel, chashivu deha let lehu kiyyuma lealmin, deha kudesha berich hu shavik lon, vela yashgach behon lealmin.

Vetanenan, amar ribbi shimon, behahi shaata kara kudesha berich hu lechol pamalya dileh, vechol retichin kaddishin, vechol cheleh umashshiryayteh, veravrevanoy, vechol chela dishmayya, veamar lon, ma attun avdin hacha, uma bene rechimay begaluta devavel, veattun hacha, kumu chutu kullechon lebavel, vaana immechon. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 43:14) ko amar Adonai lemaanchem shillachti vavela vegomer. lemaanchem shillachti vavela, da kudesha berich hu. vehoradti varichim kulam, illen kol retichin umashiryayn illain.

Kad nachtu lebavel, itpattachu shemayya, vesharat ruach nevua kaddisha al yechezkel, vechama kol ma dechama, veamar lon leyisrael, ha marechon hacha, vechol chele shemayya uretichu, deatu lemedar benechon. la hemnuhu, ad deitzterich legallaa kol ma dechama, vaere kach, vaere kach. vei galle yattir, ma degalle kolla itzterich. kevan dechamu yisrael kach, chadu. vechad shamu millin mippumeh dichezkel, la chayyshu al galutehon kelal, deha yadu dekudesha berich hu la shavik lon. vechol ma degalle birshuta galle. (31 veamar rabbi shimon beh shaata chidu yisrael chedvavta shelemata besiyyata demarehon dehava immehon vechol chad minnayyhu al reuta delibbeh birchimuta sagya lemesar nafsheh al kedushata demarehon uvegin kach galle yechezkel kol ma degalle)

Vetaninan bechol atar deyisrael galu, taman shechinta galta imhon, vehacha begaluta demitzrayim ma ketiv, veelle shemot bene yisrael vegomer. kevan dichtiv bene yisrael, mahu et yaakov, habbaim itto itzterich lememar. ella, elle shemot bene yisrael innun retichin umashshiryayn illain, denachtu im yaakov, bahade shechinta, begaluta demitzrayim
Zohar, Terumah 53: Kos shel beracha, la have ella bitlata. begin deha meraza ditlat avahan ka mitbarcha, veal da la itzterich kos ella bitlata. kos shel beracha itzterich lemehav leh bimina uvismala, ulekabbela leh ben tarvavyyhu, begin deityehiv ben yemina usemala. ulevatar yishtevik leh bimina, deha mittamman itbarcha.

Asara devarim neemru bechos shel beracha, vechullehu havo kadka yeot, begin detikkune dechos shel beracha asara innun, veha ukemuha chavrayya. kos shel beracha itzterich leashgacha beh beena, begin dichtiv, (Devarim 11:12) ene Adonai elohecha bah, vela itzterich leitnashe meena, ella leashgacha beh.

Kos shel beracha, itberach behahu bircheta, deka mevarech bar nash aleh lekudesha berich hu, begin (kach) deihu raza dimhemnuta, veitzterich lenatra leh bintiru illaa, keman deihu chashivuta demalka, deha begineh, itberach patoreh, beshaata devirkata mezona, dehahu bar nash mevarech.

Patoreh itzterich dela yehe berekanayya, deha let bircheta mishtakkecha al patora rekanayya, kema deukemuha, dichtiv, (Melachim b 4:2) haggidi li ma yesh lachy babbayit vegomer. veal da patora la itzterich leitchazaa berekanayya, deha birkan illain la sharyayn, ella baatar shelim. veraza da (Shemot 31:6) uvelev kol chacham lev natatti chachma, uchetiv (daneyalab) yahev chachmeta lechakkimin. veal raza dena shulchan delechem happanim, dichtiv, (Shemot 25:30) venatatta al hashulchan lechem panim lefanay tamid.
Zohar, Vayakhel 14: Hay nekuda tattaa kad salleka veitchazit, veitkashshitat. (sefer acher hay nekuda tattaa kad salleka leitattera baavahan) keden kol chedva ishtechach leella vetatta, vealmin kullehu bechedva. uvehay lelya, hay nekuda itpashat nehoraa, ufaris gadpoy al alma, vechol shiltonin acharanin mitabberan, unetiru ishtechach al alma.

Ucheden ittosaf ruach nishmeta beyisrael, al kol chad vechad, uvehahi nishmeta yetera, nashyayn kol itzba vechemata, vela ishtechach bar chedva, leella vetatta. hahu rucha denachit veittosaf bivne alma, kad nachit, itsache bevusemin deginta deeden, venachit veshara al amma kaddisha, zakkain innun, kad hay rucha itar.

Behahi shaata dehahu rucha nachit nachtin immah lego ginta deeden, shittin retichin, mitatterin leshit sitrin. vechad mate leginta deeden, keden kol innun ruchin venishmatin deginta deeden, kullehu (mitare lehahu mitattere (nusach acher behahu)) rucha. keruze kare veamar, zakkain attun yisrael, amma kaddisha, diruta demarichon ittear legabbayychu.

Raza derazin leyade chachmeta, zakkain innun kad hay rucha itar. hay rucha ihu itpashshetuta dehay nekuda, venafka minnah, veitpashsheta bealma, vehahu have raza deshabbat, deshara letatta, veal da ketiv beh shemira, (Shemot 31:16) veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat, veha ukemuha, shabbat la ketiv, ella et hashshabbat, leasgaa hahu rucha deshare al kolla, veitzterich lenatra leh, hoil vekayyeyma immeh devar nash, veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 56:6) kol shomer shabbat mechallelo.

Behay raza it raza achara. hay rucha, ithani behay yoma, mehanaotan deyisrael, umeinnuga dilhon, uvegin da, bae lemehav leh innuga, bemechla uvemishteya, telat zimnin, bitlat seudatin, ditlat darge mehemnuta, kema deukemuha. vehay natil chedva veinnuga, beinnun seudate deyisrael. zakkaa chulakeh, man deahane leh, umeaneg leh, behay yoma.

Hay rucha, ithane kol shita yomin, merucha illaa deattika dechol attikin. uveyoma deshabbeta, kevan denachit, veitsache beginta deeden belelya, itannag (Rosh Chodesh amud alef, 98 amud bet) meinnuga degufa, bisudate dimhemnuta, veitattar (nusach acher veitannag) hay rucha meella vetatta, veitrave bechol sitrin, beitra dilella vetatta.

Vehoil vekayyeyma immeh devar nash, itzterich leh lenatra leh. veal da ketiv veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat. shabbat, da hu hahi nekuda tattaa. et hashshabbat, da hu hay rucha, itpashshetuta dehahi nekuda. hahu itpashshetuta, kad ittosaf kiddushan uvirkan milleella, al hahi nekuda, itnehir kolla, veitavid rucha nehira bechol sitrin, itpelag leella venahir. veitpelag letatta venahir. veda hu dichtiv beni uven beni yisrael chulak achasana it lan kachada.

Chulaka dilella, itattar behay yoma, meinnuga illaa kaddisha, veithane mizziva illaa deattika dechol attikin. chulaka tattaa, itattar behay yoma, meinnuga diltatta, deithane behane seudate. veal da, bae leannega leh, bemechla uvemishteya bilvushe yekar, uvechedva decholla.

Vechad mitattera hay chulaka letatta, veitnetir kema deitzterich, salleka leella, veitchabbera behahu chulaka achara. vehay nekuda natil kolla meella vetatta, veitkelila mikkol sitrin. uvegin demitattera beshabbat, meella umittatta, kol shear yomin yahiv chela lecholla, veityeyhiv leh shuletanu meella umittatta. uverazin desifra dishlomo malka, ishtechach raza da, veukemuha butzina kaddisha, zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael.

Ketiv vayyinnafash, veukemuha vavy nefesh deavdat veshappir ihu. aval i hachi vavy gufa itzterich lememar, deminneh avdat nefesh. aval raza demilla, bevar nash it nefesh, denatla umashich legabbeh lehay rucha meerev shabbat. vehahu rucha sharya begavvav dehahi nefesh, vedayyra bah kol yoma deshabbeta. ucheden, hahu nefesh, yetera beribbuya vetoalta yattir mimma dehava.

Veal da taninan, kol nafshan deyisrael mitatteran beyoma deshabbeta, veitra dilhon, desharya hay rucha begavvavyyhu. kevan denafak shabbeta, vehahu rucha salleka leella, keden vavy lenefesh, deavdat ma deavdat. avdat hahu itra illaa, vehahu chela kaddisha dehava ba, veda hu vayyinnafash, vavy nefesh, deavdat ma deavdat.

Onatan dechakkimin, deyade razin illain, milelya deshabbeta lelelya deshabbeta, veokmuha. aval milla da shailna levutzina kaddisha, deha chazenan dehay kitra tattaa, nakta ma denakta bimama, uvelelya yahiv mezona lechol cheleh, kema deukemuha, dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha. nakta bimama, veyahava belelya. vehasheta amar mar deziuuga ishtechach behay lelya.

Amar, vadday ziuuga ishtechach belelya da. may tama. begin dehay lelya, afrishat nishmatin lechol innun chakkimin, deyadin razin dechachmeta. vechibbura, veziuuga, la ishtechach beyoma achara bechol chedva, bela irbuveya (sefer acher ella begin da) achara, kegon da. begin deinnun nishmatin difligat, feligat lon bechakkimin, betzaddikim, bachaside kedka yeot. (sefer acher vetu bechol) uvechol lelya velelya, ziuuga ishtechach vadday. ematay befalgut lelya. veha okimna. aval la bechol sitrin kehay ziuuga.

Uvegin da, chakkimin deyadin razin, bayayn lesaddera shimmusha dilhon, behay lelya. may taama. begin dechol yome deshabbeta, it lon rucha achara deshara al alma, uvehay lelya it lon rucha achara kaddisha illaa, denachta livni kaddishin, vehahu rucha nashiv meattika dechol attikin, venachta lego nekuda tattaa, lemehav bah nayycha lecholla, veda itpelig lechol sitrin, leella vetatta, kema deat amar beni uven bene yisrael.

Vechad innun chakkimin, yatvin behahu rucha kaddisha, rucha illaa, baan leshammesha arsayyhu, dehay rucha amshich avatreh letatta, kol innun nishmatin kaddishin, veyartin kaddishe elyonin, behay rucha, nishmatin kaddishin livnehon kedka yeot.
Zohar, Vayigash 11: Veatta tzuvveta zot asu kechu lachem meeretz mitzrayim vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Yeshayahu 66:10) simchu et yerushalam vegilu vah kol ohaveha sisu ittah masos vegomer. ta chaze, kad itcharav be makdesha vegarmu chovin, veitgalu yisrael meara, (Vayikra 75 amud alef) istallak kudesha berich hu leela leela, vela ashgach al charuv be makdesha, veal ammeh deitgalu, ucheden shechinta itgalleyay immehon.

Kad nachat, ashgach al beteh deittokad, istakkal al ammeh veha itgeli. shaal al matronita veittarchat. keden vayyikra Adonai elohim tzevaot bayyom hahu livchi ulemisped ulekarecha velachagor sak. vehi gam hi ma ketiv bah, (Yoel 1:8) eli kivtula chagurat sak al baal neureha. kema deat amer ki enennu, begin deistallak minah, veishtakkach piruda.

Veafillu shemaya veara, kullehu itabbalu, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 50:3) albish shamayim kadrut vesak asim kesutam. malache illae kullehu itabbalu aleh, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:7) hen erellam tzaaku chutztza malache shalom mar yivkayun. shimsha vesihara itabbalu vechashchu nehorehon. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 13:10) chashach hashshemesh betzeto vegomer, vecholla illae vetattae, bachu alah veitabbalu. may tama, begin deshalta alah sitra ochora, deshalta al ara kaddisha.

Patach veamar, (yechezkel 7:2) veatta ben adam ko amar Adonai elohim leadmat yisrael ketz ba hakketz al arba kanfot haaretz. hay kera raza illaa ihu. leadmat yisrael ketz, may ihu. vechi admat yisrael ketz hi. ella hachi hu vadday veittemar, ketz ihu limina, ketz ihu lismala. ketz limina, dichtiv, (Daniel 12) leketz hayyamin. ketz lismala, dichtiv, (iyyov 28:3) ketz sam lachoshech ulechol tachlit hu choker, veda hu (Bereshit 6:13) ketz kol basar, kema deittemar.

Ketz dimina, hayeynu dichtiv leadmat yisrael ketz. ba hakketz, da ketz dismala. ketz dimina, da ketz deyetzer hattov. ketz dismala, da ketz deyetzer hara, veda ihu dechad chovin garmu veitgabberu, itgezar veityeyhiv shaltana lemalchut harshaa leshaltaa, ulecharava beteh umikdesheh. veda hu dichtiv, (yechezkel 7:Adonai) ko amar Adonai elohim raa achar raa hinne vaa, vecholla chad.

Uvegin kach, itabbalu illae vetattae al deityeyhiv shaltano lehay ketz dismala. uvegin kach, kevan demalchu kaddisha, malchut shamayim itkafya, umalchut chayyayva (achara) itgabbar. (keden) it leh lechol bar nash, leitabbala immah, uleitkafya immah. uvegin dechad ihi yizdakkefa, vealma yitchadde, yitchadde ihu bahadah. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:10) sisu ittah masos kol hammitabbelim aleha.

Ta chaze, ketiv behu bemitzrayim, (yirmeya 46) egla yefifiya mitzrayim. veraza deegla da, havu yisrael techot shaltaneh kamma zimnin vechamma shenin. uvegin dizminin yisrael leshalletaa levatar alah, itremiz lon hasheta agalot.

Ribbi elazar amar, remez ramaz leh yosef leyaakov al egla arufa. deha behahu pirka itperash minneh. veukemuha, egla arufa, deihi atya al deishtakkach katola, vela ityeyda man katil leh. uvegin dela yishletun al ara ruchin bishin dela itzterichu, yahavin hay egla letikkuna, begin dela yishtemodun legabbeh, vela yishletu alayyhu. (leel 114 amud alef)
Ta chaze, kol bene nasha kullehu avrin al yede demalach hammavet, bar mehay deakdimu leh bene nasha, ad la yimte zimna leshalletaa beh velitol reshu. deha la shallit bevar nash, ad denatil reshu.

Uvegin kach, it leh dina leshalletaa al hahu atar. kema deat amer, (Devarim 21:1) lo noda mi hikkahu. hachi name it leh dina dela ityeyda, begin lekatrega al hahu atar. veal da, (Devarim 21:3) velakchu zikne hair hahi eglat bakar vegomer. begin leaavara dineh dehahu atar, uleittakkana dela yishlot beh mekatrega, uleishtezava minneh.

Ta chaze, yosef kad itperash meavoy, bela levaya, uvela achila ishtaddar, vehava ma dehava. vechad amar yaakov, (Bereshit 37:35) tarof toraf yosef, amar, ki ered el beni avel sheola, deana garimna leh. vetu, dahavena yada daachoy sanyayn leh, veshaddarna leh. veremez ka ramiz leh.

Amar leh ribbi yehuda, inun agalot al pi paro shaddar lon, dichtiv vayyitten lahem yosef agalot al pi paro. amar leh, diyyuka demilla, dichtiv veatta tzuvveta zot asu. veatta tzuvveta dayyka, uvegin kach ketiv beHei, mashma deyosef tava lon, uvegin kach vayyitten lahem yosef agalot al pi paro. veyaakov la itkeyyaym bemilla, ad dechama lon. dichtiv, vayyar et haagalot asher shalach yosef laset oto vattechi ruach yaakov avihem.

Amar rabbi shimon, bekadmita vattechi ruach yaakov, ulevatar vayyomer yisrael rav od yosef beni chay. ella, bekadmita kare leh orayyta yaakov, begin shuttafuta, deishtattefu shechinta behahu cherem, kad izdabban yosef. vehasheta dishchinta salka, keden ihu, vattechi ruach yaakov avihem, veda hu raza dishchinta. uvatar deihi kayyma bekiyyuma, (begin) keden darga dilela, itavar legabbah, darga deihu yisrael. (nusach acher keden darga dilella, ittear legabbah, veihu darga deyisrael) mikkan, dedarga dilela la itar leela, ad deitar bekadmita letatta, deha hacha vattechi ruach yaakov bekadmita, ulevatar vayyomer yisrael.

Vayyomer elohim leyisrael bemarot hallayla, bemarat ketiv. ta chaze, vayyizbach zevachim lelohe aviv yitzchak, bekadmita. begin leitara semala beraza dirchimu. ucheden vayyomer elohim leyisrael bemarot hallayla, behay darga dekaamaran deihi marot hallayla.

Vayyomer anochi hael elohe avicha, may tama. begin desitra dikdushsha dilela, hachi hu. deha sitra dimsaava, la adkar shema dekudesha berich hu, vechol setar dikdushsha idkar bishmeh. anochi ered immecha mitzrayma vegomer, mikkan, dishchinta nachatat immeh begaluta, uvechol atar deyisrael itgalu, shechinta itgalleya immehon, veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, kamma agalot havu. shit. kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 6) shesh eglot tzav. davar acher, shittin havu, vecholla raza chada. bekadmita ketiv baagalot asher shalach yosef, ulevassof asher shalach paro. ella, kullehu deshaddar yosef, havu bechushebana kedka chaze. veinun deshaddar paro yattir minnayyhu, la havu beraza da, vela havu bechushebana.

Veillen veillen kaatu. begin kach, asher shalach yosef, asher shalach paro. vechad yifkun yisrael min galuta ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 66:20) veheviu et kol achechem mikkol haggoyim mincha laAdonai vegomer:

ohc: Velo tissov nachala mimmatte vegomer. taam shekkafal hammaamar atzmo sheamar besamuch "velo tissov" vegomer, lefi ma shekkatavti besamuch sheen ze ella etza tova, ba maamar sheni lechiyyuv lechol bene yisrael shealehem baa mitzvat "vechol bat yoreshet" vegomer haamura kodem laze.

rashi: Mispar arecha hayu elohecha. bechol ir vair eloah acher:
targum: Vean dechaltechon daavadtun lechon yekumun im yachlan lemifrakchon beidan bishatchon are minyan kirvechon havaa dachalatchon devet yehuda:

ohc: Veet hearim vegomer et shesh are hammiklat. mikkan mashma ki hashshesh are miklat hem laggolin velo lalviyyim, umeamro bappasuk sheachar ze sheamar kol hearim asher tittenu lalviyyim arbaim ushemone, mashma shellizchut haleviyyim hem gam hashshishsha. venire ki nitkavven hakkatuv baze latet zechut shava leyisrael haggolin velalviyyim, sheyyad kullan shave, lachen befasuk rishon amar zechut laggolin sheyyihyu shesh are miklat lahem ladur bahem, uvefasuk sheni natan zechut lalviyyim, ha lamadta shehem shel leviyyim vehem shel haggolin veen haggolin maalin sachar, vechen heelu besof haggolin (makkot 13.) lechol hassevarot. vesover ani shebben levi nidche mippene yisrael haggole, im rabbu haratzchanim vehutzrechu leshesh ayayrot yiddachu haleviyyim mehem, shehare hikdim hakkatuv zechut laggolin.

Vaytzav moshe et bene yisrael vegomer. perush, shetztzivva otam al pi Adonai shetztzivvahu lemor leyisrael, uma tzivva? "ken matte vene yosef" vegomer, perush, shebbaa hammitzva meAdonai shettaanatam vedivrehem emet, vehakkavvana baze lechavod uletiferet bene yosef.

Vayyisu vegomer vayyachanu besukkot. kashe, halo kevar amar "vayyisu vene yisrael merameses" vegomer, velo haya tzarich lomar ella "vayyachanu besukkot"? venire shennitkavven lomar shello haya massa acher ben rameses lesukkot, vehu ma shessamach levayyisu" "vayyachanu", vezulat ze im haya matchil "vayyachanu besukkot" en heara laze, uchemo chen dikdek bechol hammassaot lehasemich hachaniyya lammassa (mechilta Shemot 12,37).

rashi: Vaani avo vetecha. lehodot lecha berov chasdecha shehifleta alenu, lehareotenu nekama mehem:
targum: Vaana bisgie tuvach eul levetach esgod lehechla dekudeshach bidchaltach:

rashi: Beshuray. beoyynay, kemo "beshorray" (tehillim 5:9):
Bakkamim alay mereim. al harshaim hakkamim alay shamu aznay meachore happargod (sanhedrin 89:) shello yoilu lechallot otanu, kach shamati:
targum: Veistakkalat ayni beuvedana dimike bekaymin alay leavasha shaman udenay kal tevirhon:

rashi: Ki yimmatze. bitchilla keshehu nimtza gannav, vehu haya muchzak neeman; kach tirgem yonatan:
targum: Kevahatat gevar demitchashev meheman umishtechach geniv ken behitu bet yisrael inun malkehon ravrevehun vechahanehon uneviyehon deshikra:

rashi: Halo zot taase lach. halo et haraa veet happureanut hazzot tigrom lach haashma veheavon asher azavt et Adonai elohayich:
Beet molichech baddarech. shehaya melammed otcha derech hattova vehayeshara:
targum: Hala da pureanuta titabbed minich al dishvakta yat pulechana dayya elahach deachazyach orcha takna vela halechta vah:

ohc: Vehorashtem et vegomer vishavtem vegomer. Rashi zichrono livracha peresh shehammitzva hi "vehorashtem", aval "vishavtem" hu havetacha. veramban zichrono livracha peresh shehammitzva hi "vishavtem", umikkan samchu lomar (ketuvot 110.) hakkol maalin leeretz yisrael.
Venire peshat hakkatuv kedivre Rashi, mimma sheggamar omer ki lachem vegomer lareshet otah, veim hayyeshiva hi hammitzva, haya lo litlot beikkar hammitzva velomar "ki lachem vegomer lashevet bah".

rashi: El eretz hakkarmel. "leara deyisrael dahavat menatztzeva kecharmela" (targum yonatan; Pesikta rabbati 15, 1), peresh netua keyaar:
targum: Veaelit yatchon laara deyisrael dahavat menatzva checharmela lemechal ibbah vetuvah vealtun vesaevtun yat ara bet shechinti veachsanti shavetun lefulechan taavata:

rashi: Shavarti ullech. haol shel etz nofel bo leshon shevira, vehammosrot, shehen shel or, nofel bahen leshon netika:
Mosrotayich. hem retzuot shekkoshrin bahem haol:
Vattomri lo eevor. al devarecha:
Ki al kol giva. ach atta lo shamarta havetachatcha, val kol giva at tzoa – leshon mishkav umatztza. ki meshammesh leshon ella:
targum: Are mealma tavaret nir ammaya mitzavrechon fesakit chanikechon vaamartun la nosif od lemebar al memrach are al rama menatla utechot kol ilan abbuf at palcha letaavata:

rashi: Ki en befihu nechona. nirim keohavim, vehem oyvim:
Kirbam hauot. machshevotam mirma:
Kever patuach geronam. livloa yegia acherim kekever habbolea et hagguf:
Yachalikun. divre chalaklakkot:
targum: Metul delet befumehon derashie chevanta gufehon malyan itregusheta hech sheyol fetiach geronhon lishanhon meshaain:

ohc: Kaasher tzivva Adonai et moshe ken asu. tzarich ladaat lamma shinna hakkatuv maamar ze misseder haragil shemmakdim hammaase veachar kach yomar "kaasher tzivva", vechan hikdim maamar kaasher vegomer veachar kach amar ken asu?

Venire ki lefi she asa lahem yitron livnot tzelafchad umaala vehittir lahem linnase lechol adam vehotziam mikkelal mitzva hakkelalit, ba hakkatuv lehodienu shehagam she asa habbechira beyadam, af al pi chen lo asu ella kemitzvat hammelech leam bene yisrael, vehu amro kaasher tzivva vegomer, perush kammitzva hakkelalit ken asu velo karishyon shennatan lahem. velaze im haya omer "vayyaasu benot tzelafchad vegomer kaasher tzivva" yihye nishma shehahodaa baa lomar hammaase sheasu, umodia bemaamar "kaasher tzivva Adonai" kasseder haragil lomar, aval meamro battechilla kaasher tzivva Adonai veachar kach hodaat hammaase, ze yaggid ki lo ba lehodia hammaase ella lishlol rishyon hefech mitzva hakkelalit, vehaven:
Chassalat parashat mase, salik sefer Bamidbar

rashi: Pere. shalvavtiku belaaz, veyesh loazin kuliyn belaaz:
Limmud midbar. hallamud lihyot bammidbarot; ken ahavt lanua:
Shaafa ruach. potachat et piha veshoefet ruach, uleolam hu chozer limkomo (Kohelet 1:6):

Taanatah mi yeshivenna. otah middat tanninim sheyyesh bah, ki gam hattannin shoef ruach, kema shenneemar "shaafu ruach kattannim" (yirmeya 14:6). mi yeshivenna meotah midda? ken attem, mi yuchal lahashivchem middarkechem haraa?

Kol mevaksheha lo yiafu. ki al chinnam yiafu, shello yuchelu lehassigah. uma sofah? bechadshah yimtzauneha. chodesh echad yesh bashshana shehi yeshena kol hachodesh, veaz hi nilkedet; af attem, chodesh echad (hu av) huchan lachem kevar mimot hameraggelim, shekkavu avotechem bechiyyat chinnam, bo tillachdu (sota la.). taanatah. shon degronmint belaaz. vechen tirgem yonatan: "kiruda". davar acher: leshon yelala, kemo "taaniyya vaaniyya" (Yechezkel 29:2). lashon acher: shakonteria belaaz, kemo "taanat shilo" (Yehoshua 16:6):
targum: Kearoda dimdorah bemadbera birut nafshah shatya rucha keyaroda ken kenishta deyisrael meradat uteat min orayta vela tzavya lemetav neviya amar lah kol baaha deorayti la yishtalhun bezimna yishkechunah:

rashi: Shommu shamayim. leshon timmahon, kemo hishtommu; vehu leshon tziuuy, kemo "im ko yomru elenu dommu" (Shmuel 1 14:9):
Vesaaru. leshon saar:
Charvu meod. keillu attem necheravim al bet hammikdash sheatid lecharev:
targum: Itabbalu shemaya al keden al ara deyisrael daatida lemecherav veal bet makdesha deatid leitztadaa veal deovadin bishun avadu ami lachada amar Adonai:

ohc: Lematte yehuda vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma nishtannu matte yehuda umatte shimon umatte binyamin shello hizkir nasi bahem. veulay ki leheyotam semuchim lezichron "nasi echad nasi echad" muvan ki hem nesiim, umishshelosha veelach huflag zichron hannesiut vehutzrach hakkatuv lezachro bechol echad.

Veraiti beshem rabbenu nissim gaon ki bihuda lo hutzrach, ki yadua kalev lenasi. shimon lo haya rauy lenasi mishshum maase zimri, binyamin elidad ze eldad uchevar zacha linvua (Bamidbar 11:16-29), vehorada hi lo likkarot nasi, ad kan.

Veefshar od lomar, ki lo yiches nesiut lechalev al yehuda mishshum kevod malchut sheomedet mimmennu, uchemo chen levinyamin mishshum shemmimmennu matchelet hammalchut beyisrael shehu shaul ish yemini, veshimon tamo nachon kedivre gaon.

Ulechol chayyatam. peshat hakkatuv hu lechol tzarchehem, ella shello haya tzarich lomar vechalul hu bichlal rechusham sheamar hakkatuv. verabbotenu zichronam livracha bemassechet makkot (makkot 12.) pershu shebba lomar shello nittenu ella lachayyim velo likvura, sheen kovrin bahem ella harotzeach shebba bo maamar Adonai ki sham tihye kevurato. uledivrehem zichronam livracha kashe tevat "ulechol", kevan shello ba maamar "ulechol chayyatam" ella lemaet kevurat metim, "lechayyatam" haya lo lomar, ki "ulechol" mashma shemmerabbe betashmishe hammigrash, uma gam betosefet vav "ulechol chayyatam" ribbuy. veratza lomar "ulechol" ribbuy, vehiskilu shehammiut hu hannishma mittevat "chayyatam" atzmah, o lefi shennitkavven lemaet hakkevura hutzrach lerabbot kol chutz mimmenna, veze shiur hakkatuv ulechol min tashmish shehu lachayyim. ha lamadta shello miet ella likvura, veim haya omer "lechayyatam" haya nishma shemmiet kol sheeno letzorech chayyatam legamre, veyikkansu begeder haissur devarim acherim levad hakkevura.

rashi: Balloti beshemen raanan. levalloti beshemen shel serara, balloti kemo (Bamidbar 15:9) "balul bashshemen":
targum: Vezakefta hech remna tukefi rabbeta yati bimshach revuta rativa dezayit abbuf:

rashi: Vetasech alemo. tagonen utesochech alemo:
Veyaletzu vecha. kesheyyiru sheatta tevarech reecha veohavecha:
targum: Veyechdun kol mesabberun vememrach laalam yeshabbechun vetatel alaveon veyivdechun vach rachame shemach:

rashi: Netatich sorek. sorek hu zemorot gefen tov, kelomar bene avot kesherim vetzaddikim. umidrasho: netatich sorek, hosafti lecha al sheva mitzvot shel bene noach shesh meot vashesh, keminyan sorek:
Sure. dishtorlatorsh belaaz:
Gefen nachriyya. hatztzomachat bayyearim:
targum: Vaana kayemtechon kadamay kemintzav gafna bechira kulechon avde keshot veechdin ishtanetun kodamay beovadechon mekalkelaya setetun mibbatar pulechani havetun kegefen delet beh hanaa:

ohc: Ze haddavar. amro ze haddavar, yitbaer al pi ma sheamru bemassechet bava batra (120.) veze leshonam: benot tzelafchad hutteru linnase lechol mi sheyyirtzu, shenneemar "lattov beenehem", ella ma ani mekayyem "ach lemishpachat avihen" vegomer – etza tova vechulei, ad kan. vehu amro ze haddavar, perush, lefi shekkadam veamar "ken matte vene yosef dovrim" shehaddin immam, vechazar uferash sheddin ze shel benot tzelafchad lo nichlal begeder gezerat mishpat ze, vehu amro ze haddavar asher tzivva Adonai livnot tzelafchad sheharshut beyadam lattov beenehem vegomer. vedikdek lomar "ze" lomar velo acher, shello asa Adonai maala zo berishyon ze ella lahem, vehu ma sheramaz beamro benot tzelafchad lemor sheen letevat "lemor" mashmaut, uledarkenu yechavven lomar ki va haelohim bemaamar ze leromem kevodam.

rashi: Gam bene nof vetachpanches. hem mitzrayim sheattem botchim alehem leezra:
Yiruch kadkod. leshon retzitza, kedimtargeminan "veratzutz" (Devarim 28:33): "ureia":
targum: Af bene mefis vetachpanches yiktelun gibbarach veyivzun nichsach:

rashi: Vayyimatu vayyashochu. vehem mittechilla hayu shachin umuatin meotzer raa veyagon:
targum: Vechad chavu azeru veitmaskenu min anik bishta vedavona:

rashi: Amru velibbam ninam yachad. ninam moshlehem, vechen (tehillim 72:17) "yanon shemo", (Mishlei 29:21) "veacharito yihye manon". kol moshlehem machashava achat lahem, harishonim kaacharonim, lehizdavveg lefatronam shel yisrael techilla veachar kach yizdavvegu lahem. veteda shehare sarfu chol moade el shehayu baaretz, kol batte vaad shello: pelishtim hecherivu shilo, nevuchadnetztzar hecheriv bayit rishon, vaacherim hecherivu bayit sheni:
targum: Amaru belibbehon benehon kachada okidu avahathon kol mearaya elaha beara:

rashi: Mikkerev chekcha challe. hashelichah vehotze otah mittoch chekcha vehillachem beoyvecha, kalle leshon garesh kemo "kala garesh yegaresh" (Shemot 11:1):
targum: Lema tetiv yedach viminach lemifrok min go itfach appik veshetze akta:

rashi: Tzaddik kattamar yifrach vegomer. kattamar – laasot perot, ucheerez ballevanon – lehachalif gizo:
targum: Tzadika hech dikla yelavlev perin hech arza belivnan yisge veyabed sharashin:

rashi: Mini raglech miyyachef. zo hi middatech, kefere haohevet lanua. neviay omrim lich: mini atzmech meavoda zara shello telchi yachef baggola, umini geronech millamut batztzama; vattomri al divre hanneviim noash. en michush, noashti bedivrechem. noash nokliyr belaaz:
targum: Menai riglich militchabbara leammaya ufumich milmiflach letaavat falche kochvaya veamart tavet mibbatar pulechanach la are rechimet leitchabbera leammaya uvatar pulechan taavathon ehach:

rashi: Zeritanu. efandishnosh belaaz:
targum: Mesartana hech ana lemechla uvene ammaya badarta yatana:

rashi: Velohim malki mikkedem. vahare atta teshuatenu mikkedem:
targum: Velaha malka dishchinat kudesheh milkadmin aved purekana bego ara:

ohc: Vayyisu merameses vegomer. hutzrach lomar zichron bachodesh harishon shete peamim, hagam shehaya yachol lomar "bachamishsha asar yom" umuvan haddavar shebbachodesh harishon medabber hakkatuv, o al ze hadderech "vayyisu bachamishsha asar lachodesh harishon". ulay sheramaz ma sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 15,11) ki chodesh nisan hu zeman shemmazzalam shel yisrael omed, gam zeman shelemut hahatzlacha bo hu chamishsha asar bachodesh, vehu amro vayyisu vegomer bachodesh harishon shehu zeman haamadat mazzalam, veod letosefet godel hammaaracha bachamishsha asar shehu zeman milluy hallevana, veamro lachodesh harishon lefi sheen geder ze more al rum hahatzlacha ella keshehu bachodesh hammutzlach.

Ki lakchu matte vegomer. perush, netinat taam lehakkodem, lamma higbil Adonai gevulot haaretz beseder ze, ki lakchu matte vegomer, aval zulat ze efshar shehaya Adonai marchiv lahem haggevul yoter mehaggevulot haamurim bainyan.

Lakchu nachalatam. hutzrach lichpol maamar ze paam sheniyya, lefi shechatzi shevet menashshe lo ba im bene gad uvene reuven yachad, laze yiched lo lekicha bifne atzmo. uchefi ze maamar lakchu nachalatam chozer lachatzi shevet menashshe, velaze hifsik hakkatuv bemaamar levet avotam ben shene hammattot lachatzi shevet menashshe. od yirtze bechefel haddevarim lomar ki ma shellakchu hu kefi nachalatam beemet, ki va lahem nachalatam sham kedivrehem sheamru "vaa nachalatenu elenu".

rashi: Belo yoil. baavoda zara sheen bah toelet:
targum: Ha ammaya la shevaku pulechan taavata veinun taavan delet behon tzeroch veami shevaku pulechani di bedileh ana mayti alehon yekara vaazalu batar dela yehnun lehon:

rashi: Yelid bayit. ben haama:
targum: Hacheavda hava yisrael im yelid beta hu maden itmesar levazozin:

ohc: Vayyichtov moshe et motzaehem vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma modienu hakkatuv bemaamar ze, im lomar shemmoshe ketavam, halo kol hattora moshe ketavah vehammassaot hakketuvim battora mikkelal hattora. od haya lo lomar "vayyichtov moshe et masehem". od lamma chazar lomar veelle masehem vegomer, vahalo kevar amar "elle mase" vegomer. od lamma shinna, battechilla hikdim lomar lemotzaehem veachar kach amar lemasehem, veachar kach hikdim tevat lemasehem letevat lemotzaehem:

Venire shehakkatuv nitkavven lehodienu seder ketivat hammassaot, shello nichtevu beyom echad, ella al ze hasseder: shehitchil moshe lichtov befinkaso bemitzvat hammelech miyyom sheyyatzu mimmitzrayim al ze hadderech – yom sheyyatzu mimmitzrayim katav pasuk "vayyisu bene yisrael merameses" vegomer, shene ketuvim habbaim keechad hakketuvim lefanenu ad tevat "shefatim", ucheshechanu besukkot katav pasuk "vayyisu vegomer vayyachanu besukkot", ucheshennasu missukkot katav "vayyisu missukkot", ucheshechanu beetam katav "vayyachanu beetam", vechen al ze hadderech haya kotev kol massa bizmanno ad shehiggiu learvot moav. veachar kach amar Adonai elav sheyyesadderem battora kederech shehayu ketuvim etzlo, vehu ma sheamar hakkatuv vayyichtov moshe et motzaehem – perush yom sheyyatzu mimmitzrayim vehem shene hakketuvim mivayyisu merameses" ad tevat "shefatim". veamro lemasehem – perush leseder kol masehem shennasu miyyom tzetam mimmitzrayim ad sof hammassaot. veamro al pi Adonai – lomar shemmichtav harishon atzmo haya al pi Adonai, hu amar elav sheyyihye kotev veholech. veamro veelle masehem vegomer – perush elle hem hammassaot haamurim shekkatav moshe lemotzaehem kol echad bizmanno uvimkomo, veze haetaka.

rashi: Ma lach lederech mitzrayim. lamma taazvi oti vetivtechi al mitzrayim?
Lishtot me shichor. shettibbeu zechorechem bannilus; shichor hu nilus, kema shenneemar "min hashshichor asher al pene mitzrayim" besefer yehoshua (Yehoshua 13:3):
Uma lach. limrod bi lemaan tigli lederech ashshur, lemeever nehar perat:
targum: Uchean ma lechon leitchabbera lefaro malka demitzrayim lemirme dechurechon benahara uma lechon lemigzar keyam im atturaa leaglaa yatchon lehalea maaver perat:

rashi: Shetayim raot. im hemiru yiratam bechayyotze bah, yesh kan raa achat; veachshav sheoti azvu, sheani mekor mayim chayyim, lalechet achare haavoda hazzara, shehem kvorot shel mayim mechunnasin venishbarin venisdakin, umemehem nivlaim bisdakehem, hare shetayim raot:
Lachtzov. lachpor:
