Asher lo yachilu. tinderont belaaz et memehem; shehammayim metashteshin et sefatam vechotlehem vehem noflin:
targum: Are tarten bishin avadu ami pulechani shevaku di vedileh ana mayte alehon yekara kemabbua demayin dela pesik usheo batar taavata deinun lehon keguvin tevirin dela yachlin lekayama maya:

rashi: Shetulim. yihyu hatztzaddikim bevet Adonai:
targum: Benoy yehevon shetilin bevet makdesha dayya bedarat bet elahana yelavlevun:

rashi: Tofse hattora. sanhedrin:
Veharoim. hammelachim:
Nibbeu vabbaal. beshem habbaal:
targum: Kahanaya la amaru nidchal min kodam Adonai umalfe orayta la alifu lemeda dechalti umalchaya meradu vememri unevie shikra mitnabban beshum taavata uvatar dela yehnun lehon azalu:

rashi: Velo amru ayye Adonai. ki nelech achare elohim acherim:
Arava. pelanura belaaz:
Veshucha. netuya, infushia belaaz:
Tziyya. dishgata belaaz:
Vetzalmavet. leshon choshech:
targum: Vela amaru nidchal min kodam Adonai deasik yatana meara demitzrayim dedabber yatana vemadbera baara meshar vecharov baara tzadya vetulemota baara dela ada bah enash vela ittotav enasha taman:

rashi: Lamma tarivu. ech tavou lehitvakkeach beriv velomar: lo chatanu?!
Kullechem peshatem bi. af hatztzaddikim bemashma; hayeynu deamre inshe: bahade hutza, laki karba (bava kamma tzav.):
targum: Lema attun medaman lemedan likval pitgame kulechon meradtun bememri amar Adonai:

rashi: Teyasserech raatech. sof sheraatech tavi alecha yissurin:
Umeshuvotayich. leshon "banim shovavim" (yirmeya 3:14):
Tochichuch. leshon "musar" (yirmeya 30:14):
Velo fachdati. pachad shelli lo haya belibbech lira oti:
targum: Ayteti alach yesurin vela menata mibbishtich veal dela tavta leorayta pureanuta titaved minich udei vachaze are vishata umereda ayti alach yerushelem al dishvakt yat pulechana dayya elahach vela shaveta dechalti lekavel enach amar Adonai elohim tzevaot:

ohc: Veim lo torishu vegomer vehaya vegomer. ledivrehem zichronam livracha (Megila 10:) sheamru kol makom shenneemar "vehaya" hu leshon simcha, kan nitkavven lomar shehagam shehem yotiru otam letzad haratzon vehassimcha bahem letzarchehem, hu mevasseram sheyyihyu lesikkim vegomer.

Vetzararu etchem al haaretz vegomer. perush, lo millevad sheyyachziku bechelek mehaaretz shello zechitem bo, ella gam chelek shezzechitem bo attem vishavtem bo, vetzararu etchem al chelek sheattem yoshvim bo lomar "kumu tzeu mimmennu". uferush tevat al kederech amro (Bamidbar 20:24) "al asher meritem pi", "al asher lo kiddashtem" (Devarim 32:51).

rashi: Ototenu. shehivtachtanu beyad neviecha, en anu roim otam beyamim rabbim sheanu baggola. nitnabbe asaf al yeme haggalut:
Ad ma. ad matay nihye batztzara zo?
targum: Atvana dihavu lana neviyaya la chamena let tuv neviya velet imana deyada ad ematay:

rashi: Ish damim umirma. ze amalek vezaro:
targum: Teabbed memalle chadvuta enash shade dam zakkay venichla yerachek Adonai:

ohc: Venatnu lalviyyim vegomer. perush, hagam shetztzivva Adonai shello yihye lalviyyim chelek venachala baaretz, aval betorat chesed yittenu lahem mattenat chinnam mimma shehiggiam, kedin shemmefarnesim mi shehissiga (ulay tzarich lomar shello hissiga) yado, vehu ma sheddikdek lomar arim lashavet, perush letzad hahechreach lashevet bahem vegomer, velaze kafal lomar achar kach vehayu hearim lahem lashavet, lehaircha ki maamar "lashavet" rishon hi taam hannetina, umaamar "vehayu hearim lahem lashavet" hu lomar lecha shetztzarich sheyyihyu reuyim lishiva. verazal amru (makkot 12.; arachin log.) shebba lomar shehearim yihyu lishiva, sheen osin ir migrash.

rashi: Od ariv. terem avi alechem raa, etvakkach immachem od al yede neviay, af al pi sheravti immachem kevar yamim rabbim:
targum: Bechen ana atid leitperaa minchon amar Adonai umin bene venechon deim yaabbedun keovadechon ana atid leitperaa:

rashi: Iyye chittiyyim. leiyye chittiyyim:
Iyye. ishlash belaaz:
Vekedar shilchu. velikdar shilchu lirot minhagam:
Vehitbonnu meod. vesimu lev lehistakkel baddavar yafe:

Hen. kemo im, im hemir goy mehem et elohav veaf al pi shehemma lo elohim, veammi hemir et kevodo asher bo haya nichbad. vchittiyyim vekedariyyim yoshve ohalim veroe mikne, venosim veholchim umittaltelin mimmire lemire umimmidbar lemidbar, venosim et elohehem immahem lemakom shechonim sham, vaani nasati etchem ad asher kavati etchem, vehinnachtem oti, kach tirgem yonatan. verabbotenu amru (taanit 5:): kittiyyim ovdim lammayim, vekedariyyim ovdim laesh, veaf al pi sheyyodim shehammayim mechabbin et haesh, lo hinnichu et elohehem:
targum: Are avaru lenagvat kittae vachazo velimdinat aravae shelachu veistakkalu lachada vachazo ammaya diglan mikkerach lichrach umimdina limdina natlin yat taavathon umovlin lehon imhon uvaatar deinun sharan parsin yat mashkenehon umekayymin yat taavathon vesagdin lehon eda hi uma velishan daavadat kevatchon bet yisrael:

rashi: Shorray. oynay hammetzappim sheevgod becha vetaazveni, shorray kemo "ashurennu velo karov" (Bamidbar 24:17):
targum: Adonai dabber yati betzidketach min biglal tushebchi takin kodamay orchatach:

rashi: Uveet raatam yomru. elay kuma vehoshienu. vechen targum yonatan: "uveiddan devishta atya alehon kafrin betautehon umodan kodamay veamrin rachem alana uferukena":
targum: Amrin letzelem aa avuna at ulema demitaved min avana amrin leh at beretana are achzaru befulechani kedal vela shaviu dechalti likvel afehon ucheidan devishta atya alehon kafrin betaavathon umodan kadamay veamrin rachem alana uferokana:

rashi: Mimmoatzotehem. shehem yoatzim al yisrael, veaz yismechu kol chose vach:
targum: Chayev lehon elaha yitbatlun mimilkathon besiga meradehon atkal lehon arum meradu vememrach:

rashi: Rei darkech baggay. ma asit mul bet peor (Devarim 3:29)! veode atta at machazeket beoto hadderech kivchara kalla hamesarechet deracheha:

Bichra. gemalla nekeva bechura, shehi ohevet lanua. "bichre midyan" (Yeshayahu 60:6) meturgam: "hogne midyan", vehem gemallim bechurim; kemo shemmatzinu besanhedrin (sanhedrin nov.): nefishe gemalle save detaayni mashke dehogne:
Mesarechet. machazeket bedarche neureha; leshon masrich (bava metzia 6.), sarich (gittin sach:). veyesh lechabbero im "seroch naal" (Bereshit 14:23) – kosheret darche naarutah belibbah:
targum: Echden temrin la isteavet uvatar taavat ammaya la halechet zekufi enayich al orchatich kad havet yatva vechelta lekavel bet peor dei ma avadt havet damya leyanka kalila dimkalkela orchataha:

ohc: Vehorashtem vegomer. vahagam sheamar hakkatuv beshiva amamin (Devarim 20:16) "lo techayye kol neshama", kan medabber hakkatuv chutz mishshiva amamin hannimtzain sham, velaze dikdek lomar et kol yoshve haaretz lomar afillu sheenam mishshiva amamin.
O efshar shechozer al umma sheen koach bahem lehargam, sheyyishtaddelu lehorisham velo yannichu mehem baaretz.

rashi: Yenuvun. yitzmechun:
Deshenim. shemenim veraanannim yihyu, veaz yaggidu ki yashar Adonai:
targum: Tuv kaavahathon yabedun benin besevu dehenin verativin yehon:

ohc: Shene hammattot vegomer lakchu vegomer. nitkavven bemaamar ze lomar shennachalatam hayta yachad mimmoshe meever hayyarden vegomer, velo chillek moshe chelek lechol echad bifne atzmo.

rashi: Yishagu. shoagim, leshon hove:
Kefirim. melachim:
Nitztzetu. nitztzetu baesh:
targum: Alohi yachlin malchaya yerimun kalhon veshavo areh letzadu kirvohi tzadyan mibbeli yatev:

ohc: Kaasher dimmiti vegomer. perush, chashavti bemitzvati zo lachem, veattem lo asitem, vetishshaer machshavti omedet belo kiyyum vekima bahem.

rashi: Banneter. min adama shechafin veshafin bah et habbegadim:
Borit. nikkayon, kemo "uvar levav" (tehillim 24:4). veyesh loazim borit – shavon belaaz:
Nichtam avonech. "ha keroshem kitma dela dache, ken saggiu chovech kodamay" (targum yonatan):
Ketem. taka belaaz:
Avonech. al avon haegel neemar, shehu kayyam leolam, kemo shenneemar "uveyom pakdi ufakadti alehem" (Shemot 32:34) – kol pekidot habbaot al yisrael, yihye miktzat avon haegel bahem (sanhedrin kav.):
targum: Are im tedamin leitnaka mechovayich kema dimnakan benitra umechavrin bevorita ha cherosham kitma dela deche ken sagiu chovayich kadamay amar Adonai elohim:

ohc: Elle mase vegomer. razal (Bereshit Rabba 12,3) amru: kol makom shenneemar "elle" pasal hakkodmim, uvema shellefanenu lo rainu shekkadmu bammaamar massaot zulatam lomar shennitkavven hakkatuv lefaslam. vehaya nire ki nitkavven lifsol kol massaot zulatam sheyyeshnam baolam, hagam shello huzkeru. ella sheroani shello hayu hammassaot leshevach, ulevay shello hayu baolam, ki rubbam hayu leyissurin shel avon hameraggelim. gam hakkodmim hayu derech rechoka leval yittenu rosh veyashuvu, dichtiv (Shemot 13:17) "velo nacham elohim derech eretz pelishtim". ha lamadta shello haya leratzon uleseder hannachon lemoade ragel. gam amru razal (yalkut yitro 273) veze leshonam: "vechol netivoteha shalom" – bikkesh hakkadosh baruch hu litten hattora leyisrael kesheyyatzu mimmitzrayim, vehayu cholkin ellu im ellu vechulei, ma ketiv "vayyisu missukkot vayyachanu veetam", hayu nosim bimriva vechonim bimriva vechulei, ad kan. ucheferush ze en bemassaot ellu davar yekar haerech lifsol kol zulatam.

Veefshar ki lefi sheyyesh bammassaot elle haamurim bapparasha shete haderagot: 1 hem hammassaot shehayu beshana rishona kodem gezerat meraggelim, 2 hammassaot sheasu bishvil gezerat hammeraggelim shello haya bedaat Adonai asot zulat ma sheasu bishte shanim, umassaot ellu geruim hem meerech shelleacharehem, uchenegdan nitkavven Adonai bemaamar elle lefaslam. veze shiur hakkatuv elle mase vegomer, perush, haamurim besamuch hem hammassaot haruyim vehatztzerichin, vechol zulatam pesulin hem, shello hayu ella yissurin lahaniam bammidbar betochachot shel avon hameraggelim.

Od nire behair lamma bachar hakkatuv limnot hammassaot velo hachanayot, uma gam ledivrehem zichronam livracha (midrash Rabba kan) sheamru mashal lemelech vechulei kan yashannu kan vechulei, ad kan, shezze yoter bezichron hachanayot, lo bammassaot. gam lefi midrash acher (tanchuma) sheamru shehizkir hammassaot likboa lahem sachar leatid lavo, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 35:1) "yesusum midbar" vegomer, lefi ze haya rauy limnot hachanayot.

Achen yitbaer al pi divre anshe emet (Zohar chelek 2 157.) sheamru shehalichat yisrael bammidbar hayta levarer nitzotze hakkedushsha sheanas ish habbeliyyaal hachone bammidbar hashshamem, sheshsham kana mekomo mekom nachash saraf veakrav, vedarchu sham adat Adonai lehotzi balo mippiv. vehu hattaam shehayu yisrael chonim bemakom echad shana uvemakom acher shetem esre shaot, shehu kefi ma shetztzarich leverur hannitzotzot sheyyeshnam bammakom hahu. uverur ze en koach baolam sheyyachol asoto zulat kedushsha hashshelema uvesod shelemut machberet hakkelalut umachberet happeratut: kedushsha hashshelema hi hashshechina veyisrael vehattora, umachberet happeratut hem shishshim ribbo neshamot kedoshot, machberet hakkelalut hu moshe rabbenu besod "moshe ammo" (Yeshayahu 63:11), ki hu ilan shemmimmennu notztzu nishmot shishshim ribbo shehayu sham, venistayyeu beezer elohi bishchunat shochen habbira, veshibberu malteot avval uverru berur atzum.

Uchefi ze tachlit hammaase hu keshennosim hayu nosim immahem kol haddome lemin hakkodesh, lo bizman hachaniyya sheadayin lo naasa immo davar. vehu ma sheramaz bemaamar elle mase – elle pasal kol hammassaot shebbaolam, sheen massa kaze shehayu nosim immahem hon kadosh veyakar sheen aroch elav. vahagam shekkadmu haavot vedarchu mekomot veasu chelkam beverure nitzotzot, lo higgiu legader ze. veamar hakkatuv atzmo taam illuy massaot elle lefi shehem shel bene yisrael asher yatzu meeretz mitzrayim venitzrefu bechur habbarzel shehi eretz mitzrayim kaamur, uvaze hayu nishmotam reuyim levarer nitzotze hakkedushsha bechol hammakom asher yavou shamma. veod letzivotam shehi shelemut hatztzava asher tishre alav hashshechina shehu mispar shishshim ribbo, ufachot mimmispar ze eno begeder hashshelemut.

Vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba amud alef, mechilta yitro) ki lesibba zo lo natan Adonai hattora larishonim, shello haya bahem shelemut hatztzava shettishre alehem shechina hannikret tzevaot. gam ramaz betevat letzivotam hasheraat shechina immahem. hare lefanecha zichron am kadosh vezichron mispar hashshalem vehasheraat hashshechina, ucheneged machberet kelalut mispar hashshalem amar "beyad moshe veaharon", moshe hu machberet mispar hashshalem, veaharon hu shoshvin hashshechina hammakriv umeyached eleha kol haanafim kayyadua besod hakkarban:

Asher yatzu meeretz mitzrayim letzivotam. lefi ma shepperashnu ki tevat "elle" higgida al hammassaot hammuvcharim ufasla massaot haggeruim, samach hakkatuv lemaamar "elle" maamar asher yatzu vegomer letzivotam, lehaircha ki hammuvcharim hem otam shekkadmu lammeraggelim, shehem bene yisrael sheyyatzu meeretz mitzrayim letzivotam. perush, hatztzevaot atzman, sheyyatzu lishlol massaot shehayu mizzeman hammeraggelim, shello hayu letzivotam, shennigzera gezera lamut bammidbar, umeotah shana atzmah metu chelek mehem velo haya bannimtza hatztzevaot sheyyatzu mimmitzrayim. veamro beyad moshe veaharon, perush, hammassaot hayu beyadam, dichtiv befarashat behaalotcha (Bamidbar 9:20): "veal pi Adonai yissau" vegomer "al pi Adonai beyad moshe", vesamach immo aharon sheaharon hu hattokea bachatzotzrot lemassaam, laze shittefo im moshe.

targum: Veashre taman kafnim veatkinu karta meyatva:
Shade basranuta al ravrevanaya veatiunun bilma dela orcha:
Shavitana lemitla veammaya tiltul resha beumaya:
Kidnan amar Adonai ma ashkachu avahatchon bememri shekar are itrechaku midchalti uteo batar taavata vahavo lilma:
Arum ha vaale devavach Adonai arum ha vaale devavach yehovdun lealma deate mitparshin min siathon detzadikaya kol avde shekar:
Uzera chaklin unetzivu charmaya vaavadu peri ibba:
Zabbanta amach magan dela mamona vela asgeta kinyana beferugehon:
Kabbilu pitgama dayya bet yaakov vechol zarit bet yisrael:
Uvarchinun veyisgun lachada uveirehon la yazer:
Shavitana kelana leshevavana memiknuta veturepita lechazranutana:
Ad ematay elaha yechased meika yarchik beel devava shemach lealma:

bart: Rabbi omer. sheyyavor. sheyyivror:

Kol shehi tiferet leoseha vetiferet lo min haadam. sheyyehe noach lo, veyihyu nochin bene adam mimmennu. veze yihye, kesheyyelech bechol hammiddot badderech haemtzai velo yitte leechad mishshene hakketzavot. sheim hu kilay beyoter, yesh tiferet lo, sheosef mamon harebe, aval en bene adam mefaarin oto bemidda zo. veim hu mefazzer yoter min harauy, bene adam hamekabbelim mimmennu mefaarim oto, aval eno tiferet leoseha veeno noach lo, shehu ba lide aniyyut bishvil kach. aval middat hannedivut shehi emtzait ben hakkilut vehappizzur, hi tiferet leoseha, sheshshomer et mamono veeno mefazzer yoter min harauy. vetiferet lo min haadam, shebbene adam mefaarim oto, shennoten kemo sherauy lo litten. vechen haddin bechol shear hammiddot:

Sheen atta yodea mattan secharan shel mitzvot. lo nitparesh battora sechar hamekayyem mitzvot ase, velo onesh hamevattel measotan. deillu anshan shel mitzvot lo taase meforashin hen, sekila, serefa, hereg, vechenek, karet, umita bide shamayim, umalkot. haonesh hakkal laavera kalla vehechamur lachamura:

Veheve mechashshev hefsed mitzva. ma sheatta mafsid missechoratcha umamoncha mippene esek hammitzva, keneged hassachar sheyyaale lecha mimmennah baolam hazze o baolam habba, sheyyihye yoter meoto hefsed:
Usechar avera. hanaa sheatta nehene baavera, keneged hefsed sheatid lavo lecha mimmennah:
Sukkato keva. sheim yesh lo kelim naim umatztzaot naot, maalan lassukka:

Mishshettisrach hammikpa. mishshettikkalkel hammikpa. kol tavshil sheeno lo rach velo kashe ella kafuy karuy mikpa. verov bene adam moasin tavshil kaze, uvimat mayim mitkalkel legamre. umikpa shel gerisin shel pol hi memaheret lehitkalkel baggeshamim yoter mishshear mikpot, veim yardu geshamim ad sheillu haya lefanav mikpa shel gerisin hayta mitkalkelet, muttar lefannot miyyad:
Veshafach lo. rabbo kiton al panav shel eved, kelomar i efshi beshimmushecha. af kan geshamim hallalu marin sheen hakkadosh baruch hu mekabbel maasehem beratzon:
Hashshoket. even chalula sheal sefat hammayan, vehammayim nichnasin lah derech chor shebbedafnah, umashkin bah habbehemot:
En memalleim mimmenna. mayim leme chattat:

Veen mekaddeshin bah. en notnim efer para al hammayim shebbetochah, deenah chashuva cheli. vehacha mayre vesela mechubbar shechakako, vaafillu talush shechibbero ulevassof chakako, hoil velo haya alav shem keli vattalush eno chashuv keli:

Veenah tzericha tzamid patil. im hi veohel hammet, matztzelet al ma shebbetochah bechissuy levad belo tzamid patil, lefi sheenah chashuva cheli ella chevor vedut shemmatztzilim al ma shebbetocham bechissuy levad:
Veenah poselet et hammikve. im naflu me geshamim mittochah lammikve en necheshavim mayim sheuvim lifsol et hammikve:
Vechamma yehe vannekev. levattelah mittorat keli shello tifsol et hammikve mittaam sheiva:
Kishfoferet hannod. veshiuro sheyyihyu shete etzbaot shel yad hassemuchot laggudal chozrot berachban berevach betoch hannekev:
Shoket yehu. kach hayta nikret:

Vechol tohorot shel yerushalayim nitbalim al gabbah. shemmatbilim betochah veosim tohorot. velo haya vashshoket arbaim sea, ella mikve shalem haya vetziddah, ume hashshoket mitarvim bo derech nekev kishfoferet:
Ad sheyyippachet rubbah. afillu yesh bannekev kishfoferet hannod, leolam torat keli aleha ad shettishshaver rubbah:
Tovlin. bene adam kol gufo:
Umatbilin. hakkelim, vehayyadayim lemidi devae tevilat yadayim velo saggi vintila, kegon lakkodesh:
Mayan. shemmemav novim, vehammayim hannovim meattim min hammayim sheuvin sheshshafchu vetocho:

Shave lammikve letaher beashboren. velo vezochalin. dekayma lan mayan metaher bezochalin umikve metaher beashboren, vehay mishshum mayim sheuvim merubbim shebbo shave lammikve letaher beashboren velo vezochalin:
Velammayan lehatebil bo bechol shehu. velo vae arbaim sea kemikve, deen mikve metaher befachot mearbaim sea, vehay metaher bechol shehu chemayan:

Lo alecha hammelacha ligmor. lo secharcha hakkadosh baruch hu ligmor et kullah kede shettafsid secharcha im lo tigmerennah. veshemma tomar eni lomed veeni notel sachar, velo atta ven chorin libbatel. al karchacha haol, muttal alecha laavod:
Leatid lavo. laolam habba:

Hammanniach kelim tachat hatztzinnor. marzev shemme geshamim nichnasim bo veyordim derech piv lammikve. vehacha mayre vetzinnor shel etz shekkevao ulevassof chakako, dehoil velo haya torat keli alav keshekkevao, af al pi shechakako achare chen la chashive hammayim shebbetocho mayim sheuvim, hoil velo haya torat keli alav betalush:
Veechad kelim ketannim. delo tema dela chashive:
Afillu chele gelalim. dela chashive chelim leinyan tuma, chashive chelim lifsol et hammikve, afillu im shevaram o chafa otam, delo dame lemanniach kankannim berosh haggag lenaggevan:

Uvet hillel metaharin beshocheach. beferek kamma deshabbat baggemara, mokme felugetayhu keshehinnichan tachat hatztzinnor bishat kishshur avim venitpazzeru ushechachan vechazru venitkashsheru, devet shammay savre mishshum pizzur avim lo nitbattela machashavto harishona, degalle dateh sheratza sheyyippelu letochan. uvet hillel savre batla machashavto, dechi nitpazzeru, assach dateh, dekasavar lo yerdu geshamim od. aval hinnichan tachat hatztzinnor bishat kishshur avim veecharu haggeshamim lavo veyatza limlachto ushechachan, divre hakkol hoil umittechilla lechach nitkavven lo vatla machashavto veshichchato. veim hinnichan bishat pizzur avim, divre hakkol tehorim, shello nitkavven mittechilla lechach:

Beshocheach bechatzer shehu tahor. bechatzer shello tachat hatztzinnor, venitmalleu min hannotfin venaflu lammikve. dedavka tachat hatztzinnor hu diflige vet shammay, degalle dateh deratza sheyyippelu letochan, umishshum pizzur lo vatla machashava kammayta. aval manniach bechatzer, afillu vishat kishshur, lo muchecha meikkara machashavto kammayta shappir, hilkach batla cheshennitpazzeru:
Adayin machaloket bimkomah omadet. shello amdu leminyan al kach velo rabbu talmide vet shammay:
Bulmus. choli haochez mechamat reavon umesukkan lamut, ucheshemmarito chozeret beyadua shennitrappe:

Kelev shote. ruach raa shora alav. vesimanim shello, piv patuach, riro notef, aznav seruchot, uzenavo munachat lo ben yarchotav, umehallech al tzidde reshut harabbim, veyesh omrim af noveach veen kolo nishma:
En maachilin oto mechatzar kaved shello. veaf al pi shennahagu harofim birfua zo, enah refua gemura lehattir lo issur behema temea al kach:
Verabbi matya ven charash mattir. kasavar refua gemura hi. veen halacha kerabbi matya ben charash:
Hachoshesh beshinnav. shemmatchil besar hachanichayim lehitakkel umishsham holech lachech velaggaron:
Mattilin lo sam. shoresh esev lirfua:

Vechol sefek nefashot doche et hashshabbat. kol, laatoye kegon difshita lan divshabbat zo lo yamut, ella safek sheim lo yaasu lo hayyom shemma yamut leshabbat habbaa. uchegon daamaduhu lishtot sam ze litmanya yome, veyoma kamma shabbeta, mahu detema leakkevinhu ad leorta ki hechi delo nechul aleh tere shabbata, ka mashma lan:
Bayit shennifchat. gaggo beemtzao, vehaddefanot rechokot min hassechach kasher:

Im yesh min hakkotel lischach kasher arba ammot pesula. pachot mikkan keshera. dahalacha lemoshe missinay deamrinan dofen akuma ad arba ammot, veroim tikrat habbayit keillu neekam rosh haddofen uva ad hassechach hakkasher. velo yishan tachteha:
Vechen bechatzer shehi mukkefet achsadra. vesikkech baavirah shel chatzer, rachok mikkatle haachsadra. veachsadra hu makom mukkaf mishshalosh mechitztzot:
Sukka gedola. kol sheillu yinnatel hassechach pasul, yishshaer bah shiva tefachim al shiva tefachim sechach kasher, zo hi sukka gedola:

Shehikkifuha vedavar sheen mesakkechin bo. davka min hatztzad amrinan sheen sechach pasul posel ella bearba ammot, mishshum taama dedofen akumma. aval beemtza hassukka posel bearbaa tefachim. vaavir sheen sham sechach kelal ben baemtza ben min hatztzad, posel bishlosha tefachim:

Mefakkechin alav. chofrin et haggal umechappesin acharav. veim badku ad chatmo, ben millemala lematta, ben millematta lemala, velo matzu bo neshama, beyadua shehu met veshuv en mefakkechin alav, dichtiv (Bereshit 7) kol asher nishmat ruach chayyim beappav:
Metzauhu chay mefakkechin alav. lo nitzrecha ella sherau bo shei efshar sheyyichye ella chayye shaa umiyyad hu met, ka mashma lan dimfakkechin alav bishvil oto chayye shaa:

Met en mefakkechin alav. ha ka mashma lan daafillu ledivre haomer matztzilin et hammet mippene haddeleka, beha mode deen mefakkechin. degabbe deleka hittiru letaltel hammet ulehotzio, dei lo sharet leh ate lechabboye mittoch sheadam bahul al meto, aval hacha i lo sharet leh lefakkeach et haggal may it leh lemebad dithave issura deorayta denishre ha mikkame ha:
Leeppikoros. leshon hefker, shemmevazze et hattora umachshivah keillu hi hefker. i nammi, mesim atzmo kehefker veeno chas al nafsho lachush shemma tavo alav raa al shemmevazze et hattora o lomdeha:
Veda lifne mi atta amel. bitshuva zo sheatta meshiv leeppikoros, shello yifte libbecha lintot ledato:
Mikkeli echad mishshenayim vechulei. siyyuma demilletayhu derabbanan hi:
Tisha kabbin mayim. baal keri chole sheeno yachol litbol, im natnu alav tisha kabbin mayim, tahor. veashmeinan matnitin delo shena mikkeli echad lo shena mishshenayim o shelosha chelim:

Vechen tahor shennaflu al rosho veal rubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin. defosel et hatteruma, kidamrinan perek kamma deshabbat [daf 13], hane shelosha luggin mishshenayim o shelosha chelim mitztarfin, mearbaa en mitztarfin:
Bamme devarim amurim. demishshenayim ushelosha chelim mitztarfin:
Bizman shello nitkavven lerabbot. ammikve kae, shello nitkavven lehosif alav kede leharebot bo mayim:
Afillu kortov. shiur muat, echad mishshishshim vearbaa ballog:
O shehalach bahen hattame veshata tahor tahor. sheen me gevaim alulim lekabbel tuma ad sheyyittalshu, kedaamaran leel:

Echad me gevaim me vorot me shichin. kullehu shavin lechol haddinim ditninan bematnitin ad hammaala hashshenit. borot, hen asuyin agullin. shichin, arukkin uketzarim. mearot, merubbaot umechussot bekeruy ella sheyyesh lahen pe:

Me tamtziyyot sheppasku. geshamim hayyordim al heharim umitmatztzin hammayim umevabein min heharim leachar sheppasku haggeshamim ufasku heharim mizzechilatan, otan hammayim hannisharim hen keme gevaim, veim shata mehen adam tame o mille vichli tame o naflu vahen mashkin temein, en hattippa hattemea mitbattelet bahen. aval kol zeman shello fasku heharim mizzechilatan, af al pi sheppasku haggeshamim, en nechshavin keme gevaim, ume haggeshamim hannizchalin achar kach min heharim mevattelim hattippa hattemea af al pi shehammayim harishonim lo vitteluha. vehachi tenan beferek 2‏ demachshirin (mishna 3), me shefichot sheyyardu alehem me geshamim, im rov min hattahor, tahor, ematay, bizman shekkadmu me shefichot, aval kadmu me geshamim, afillu chol shehu, me shefichot tame:
Hakkerovim lair veladderech temeim. dechayshinan shemma shata [mehen] tame o mille vichli tame:
Ad sheyyehallechu rov bene adam. hashshayyarot haholchot bederech rechoka. deaz temeim, shemma shata mehen adam tame o mille vichli tame:

Nashim vaavadim uketannim kulei. deamar kera (Vayikra 23) kol haezrach beyisrael, lehotzi et hannashim, deaf al gav dechayyavot baachilat matztza lel rishon shel pesach en chayyavot bassukka lel rishon shel chag:

Katan sheeno tzarich leimmo. kol shenneor mishshenato veeno kore imma imma have en tzarich leimmo vechayyav ufachot mikkan patur. vechen halacha. vedavka shekkore veshone veeno shotek ad shettavo immo elav hu denikra tzarich leimmo, aval kore paam achat veshotek lav tzarich leimmo hu:
Rabbi yehuda omer im enah yechola laamod bifne atzmah pesula. rabbi yehuda letaameh deamar sukka dirat keva bainan. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Meduvlelet. shello hishkiv hakkanim yachad ze etzel ze, ella kane ole vekane yored, umittoch kach chammatah merubba mitztzillatah, veashmeinan matnitin deamrinan roim keillu hayu mushkavim beshave, veim az tzillatah merubba keshera:
En meannin otam. en chayyavin limnoa mehen maachol:
Mechannechin otan. leshaot. haya ragil leechol bearba shaot, maachilin oto bechamesh o beshesh, kefi koach habben:
Kodem leshana. shana achat kodem lefirko, im hattinok chole vetash kocho veeno yachol lisbol:

Vekodem lishtayim. o shete shanim kodem pirko im hattinok bari. ufirkan have hattinoket bat shetem esre shana veyom echad sheen darkah lehavi simanim ad zeman ze, veaz hi bat anshin. ufirko shel tinok have ben shelosh esre shana veyom echad, vekodem ze eno bar anshin:
Ol malchut. massa melech vesarim:
Derech eretz. amal vetorach happarnasa, lefi shemmelachto mitbarechet:
Happorek mimmennu ol tora. haomer kashe ullah shel tora veeni yachol lesovlah:
Arba esre seudot. shete seudot bechol yom leshiva hayyamim:
En laddavar kitzva. im ratza leechol lo yochal chutz lassukka. ratza lehitannot yitanne veen nizkakin lo:
Chutz millele yom tov harishon. deyalfinan chamishsha asar chamishsha asar mechag hammatztzot, ma achilat matztza layla harishon chova, mikkan vaelach reshut, af sukka ken:
Yashlim belele yom tov haacharon. belel shemini atzeret. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer bishtehen:
Meematay tohoratan. shel kerovim urechokin:

Mishsheyyirbu veyishtofu. mishsheyyerdu geshamim veyirbu me haggeshamim al hammayim shehayu vahem kevar kodem sheshshata [mehem] hattame o shemmille mehem bichli tame, vegam sheyyihyu shotfin veyaavru al sefat haggeve veyetzu lachutz. veshiur hashshetifa, kol shehu:

Rabbu. lo chevet shammay devau tarvayhu sheyyirbu veyishtofu, ella kevan sherabbu me geshamim shebbau achar kach al hammayim shehayu vahen bishat tumatan, nitharu, af al pi shello shatfu veyatzu lachutz:
Rabbi shimon omer shatfu. me geshamim al gedotav shel geve veyatzu lachutz, nithar haggeve:
Af al pi shello rabbu. me haggeshamim shebbau achare chen al hammayim shehayu vaggeve vishat tumatan:
Kesherim lachalla. me gevaim hallalu ditnan bematnitin, kesherim lehishtammesh bahen lachalla, lalush ulevashshel bahen challa:
Velittol mehen layyadayim. lechol davar shetztzarich netilat yadayim:
O shessemachah. shehitta rashe hakkanim al hakkotel veholchim beshippua lematta laaretz:
Mippene sheen lah gag. eno nikkar mahu gag umahu kotel. deohel meshuppa lav shemeh ohel ella im ken yesh lo gag tefach. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:

Machtzelet shel kanim vechulei. bemachtzelet ketanna kulle alma lo pelige distama lishchiva veen mesakkechin bah. ki pelige bigdola, tanna kamma savar setam gedola lesikkuch avida, usetam ketanna lishchiva. vehachi kaamar, machtzelet gedola setama lesikkuch, veim peresh sheasaah lishchiva, mekabbelet tuma veen mesakkechin bah. ulesikkuch, mesakkechim bah, hachi kaamar, umachtzelet ketanna setama lishchiva, veim peresh sheyyehe lesikkuch mesakkechin bah:

Rabbi eliezer omer achat gedola veachat ketanna. setaman lishchiva. vaasaah lishchiva dekaamar, kelomar asuyot hen mittechillatan setama lishchiva, hilkach af haggedola mekabbelet tuma veen mesakkechin bah. veim peresh shehi lesikkuch mesakkechin bah. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Bishlomah shel malchut. vaafillu shel ummot haolam:

Chayyim belao. dichtiv (Chavakuk 1) vattaase adam kidge hayyam, ma dagim shebbayyam kol haggadol mechavero bolea et chavero, af bene adam ilmale moraah shel malchut kol haggadol mechavero bolea et chavero (avoda zara 4.):
Yire Adonai ish el reehu. hare kan shenayim:
Veyiddom. leshon kol demama dakka, kederech hashshone yechidi shehu shone belachash:
Ki natal alav. keillu netinat kol hattora kullah hayta baavuro bilvad:

Ase toratcha keva. sheyyihye ikkar iskecha bayyom uvallayla battora, ucheshettihye yagea min hallimmud taase melacha. velo sheyyihye ikkar iskecha bammelacha ucheshettifne min hammelacha taasok battora. umatzati katuv, ase toratcha keva, shello tachmir leatzmecha vetakel laacherim, o tachmir laacherim vetakel leatzmecha, ella tehe toratcha keva lecha kemo laacherim, vechen hu omer beezra (7) ki ezra hechin levavo lidrosh et torat Adonai velaasot ulelammed livne yisrael, kemo shehechin libbo laasot kach haya melammed livne yisrael:
Emor meat vaase harebe. kemo shemmatzinu beavraham avinu alav hashshalom, sheamar techilla (Bereshit 14) veekkecha fat lechem, uvassof vayikkach ben bakar rach vatov:

Veheve mekabbel et kol haadam. kesheatta machnis orchim levetcha lo titten lahem ufanecha kevushot bakkarka, shekkol hannoten ufanav kevushot bakkarka afillu natan kol mattanot shebbaolam maalin alav keillu lo natan kelum. shalosh azharot hizhir shammay, keneged shalosh maalot shehizkir yirmeya, chacham gibbor veashir. keneged chacham amar ase toratcha keva, keneged ashir amar emor meat vaase harebe, keneged gibbor amar heve mekabbel et kol haadam besever panim yafot, sheyyichbosh yitzro veyillachem keneged libbo hara, veshaninu (lekamman 84 41) ezehu gibbor hakkovesh et yitzro:

Akavya. mittippa serucha. tippat shichvat zera. veaf al pi shebbishat haibbur enah serucha, sheenah masrachat berechem haishsha ad leachar shelosha yamim ucheshettasriach enah reuya lehazeria, mikkol makom kare lah tippa serucha mippene shehi kerova lehaseriach miyyad keshehi chutz lime haishsha. vehammistakkel shebba mittippa serucha, nitztzol min haggaava. vehammistakkel sheatid lelech limkom afar rimma vetolea, nitztzol min hattaava vehachemda el hammamon. vehammistakkel sheatid litten din vecheshbon, poresh min hachet veeno nichshal baavera:
Hammanniach tavla tachat hatztzinnor. lehameshich hammayim lammikve:
Im yesh lah levizbez. safa saviv mearba ruchoteha, kede sheyyihye lah bet kibbul:
Poselet et hammikve. dahavu lehu mayim sheuvim. umishshum tzinnor lo haya mippesil mikve, deayre vetzinnor shekkevao ulevassof chakako kedifrishit:
Zekafah liddoach. kede shettudach mittinnofet shebbah:
Enah poselet et hammikve. delo kayma chederech kabbalatah:
Echeta veashuv echeta veashuv. tere zimne:
En maspikin beyado vechulei. shekkevan sheavar avera veshana bah shuv eno poresh mimmenna, lefi sheddoma alav kehetter:
Ase retzono chirtzoncha. pazzer mamoncha becheftze shamayim, kirtzoncha, keillu pizzarta otam bachafatzecha. sheim asita chen yaase retzoncha kirtzono, kelomar yitten lecha tova beayin yafa:

Kede sheyyevattel retzon acherim. yafer atzat kol hakkamim alecha leraa. vaani shamati, sheen ze ella derech kavod kelappe maala, vahare hu keillu katuv kede sheyyevattel retzono mippene retzoncha. keotah sheamru beferek bamme ishsha (shabbat 63.) kol haose mitzva ketiknah afillu gezar din shel shivim shana mitbattel mealav:
Al tifrosh min hatztzibbur. ella hishtattef betzaratam. shekkol happoresh min hatztzibbur eno roe benechamat hatztzibbur (taanit 11.):
Veal taamin beatzmecha ad yom motcha. shehare yochanan kohen gadol shimmesh bichhunna gedola shemonim shana ulevassof naasa tzedoki (berachot 29.):
Veal tadin et chavercha ad shettaggia limkomo. im raita chavercha shebba lide nissayon venichshal, al tedinehu lechova ad shettaggia lide nissayon kemoto vetinnatzel:

Veal tomar davar shei efshar lishmoa vesofo lehishshamea. kelomar, lo yihyu devarecha mesuppakim shei efshar lehavinam bitchilla uveiyyun rishon, vetismoch sheim yaamik hashshomea bahem levassof yevinem. ki ze yavi bene adam litot bidvarecha, shemma yitu veyetzu leminut al yadcha. perush acher, lo tegalle sodcha afillu bencha leven atzmecha vetomar sheen kan mi sheyyishmaacha, lefi shessofo lehishshama, ki of hashshamayim yolich et hakkol. vehaggirsa hi lefi perush ze, shessofo lehishshama. aval Rashi gores, veal tomar davar sheefshar lishmoa shessofo lehishshama. uvedivre tora medabber, al tomar al devar tora sheatta yachol lishmoa achshav shettishma oto levassof, ella hat aznecha ushema miyyad:
Lichsheippane. measakay, eesok battora:

Ase lecha rav. leinyan horaa medabber achshav, im ba din lefanecha venistappakta bo, ase lecha rav, vehistallek min hassafek. velo tifsok alav atta levaddecha. ki ha derava ki have ate terefta legabbeh have mechannef lechullehu tabbache demata machsayya, amar, ki hechi delimteyan shiva mikkeshura:

Veal tarbe leasser omadot. shehammafrish maasrot meomed eno nitztzol min hakkalkala. im pochet mimma sherauy litten maasrotav metukkanim uferotav mekulkalim. veim heedif al shehaya rauy litten, perotav metukkanim umaasrotav mekulkalim:

Neshar. shello yehu alin vekismin yordin al hashshulchan. perush acher shello yinsheru healin leachar sheyavshu vetishshaer hassukka chammatah merubba mitztzillatah. vesadin davar hamekabbel tuma hu, ufasul lischach. vedavka mippene hanneshar, aval lenaotah keshera:

O shepperas al gabbe hakkinof. kelomar o afillu lo peraso mippene hanneshar, ella lenoy al mittato al gabbe hakkinof, shehen arbaa kunedasin learba ragle mittato shehen gevohin, umeniach kelonsot mizze laze al gabbehen, ufaras sadin alehem vehirchiko min hassechach, dehashta lo mesakkech bedavar hamekabbel tuma, deha lav lesakkuche shatcheh hatam:
Pesula. mishshum deeno yoshev bassukka, deohel mafsik benehem:

Aval pores hu al gabbe mitta sheyyesh lah naklitin. sheenan ella shenayim, vehen yotzin beemtza hammitta echad limraashoteha veechad leragleha, venotnin mizzo lezo [kelonsa, ufores alav sadin], umishshum deen lah gag tefach rachav millemala lo mikkere ohel:
Naflu mayim temeim. hacha ashmeinan shemme gevaim hallalu mekabbelin tuma al yede mashkin temein shennaflu vahen:

Rabbi shimon omer ben shehediach ben shello hediach. akkullehu kae rabbi shimon, ben attuma shebbaa mechamat adam, ben mechamat keli, ben mechamat mashkin, bechullehu sevira leh ben hediach ben shello hediach tame hakkikkar. vetaama derabbi shimon, sheani omer shettippat hammayim temeim shennaflu mippi hattame o min hakkeli o min hammashkin temein, levassof keshennaflu chol hammayim nishtayyera hattippa hahi al hakkikkar vetimmeattu. veen halacha cherabbi shimon:
Hassayyad. umman hassad et habbor besid kede sheyyachazik memav, vedarko lehavi hassid labbor beatzitz, veoto vor hayu vo mayim kesherim venishka heatzitz letoch hammayim venitmalle:
Im hayu hammayim tzafim al gabbav kol shehu yeshabber. shello nishavu hammayim, dechol shaa hen meoravin. aval im haya maale heatzitz beyado hayu nifsakim venaasim telushin:
Veim lav. sheen hammayim tzafim al gabbav:
Lo yeshabber. uchesheenah onat geshamim ayre. deim haya onat geshamim kevan deikka mayim babbor yeshabber, kedaamaran:
Rabbi yehoshua omer ben kach uven kach yeshabber. deyachol lehameshich, kidfarishna leel:
Mayim sheuvim. shehen pesulim lammikve:
Ume geshamim. hakkesherim:
Shennitarvu vechatzer o vaukka. gumma shehammayim mitkabbetzim bahen, o al maalot hammeara, umishsham nimshechu veyardu lammikve:
Im rov min hakkasher. kegon sheesrim veechad sea mehen me geshamim vetisha asar mayim sheuvin, kasher:
Hayu mekallechin betoch hammayim. shello yardu lammikve al yede hameshacha derech hechatzer vehaukka umaalot hammeara, ella min hakkelim atzman hayu mekallechin letoch hammikve:

Veim lav pasul. dishlosha luggin mayim sheuvim poslim keshennaflu lammikve shello chederech hameshacha. aval derech hameshacha en poslin ad sheyyihyu harov mayim sheuvim, afillu hammayim sheuvin bifne atzman shello nitarvu vakkesherim, en poslin derech hameshacha ella verov. kegon mikve sheyyesh bo esrim veachat sea me geshamim, memalle vakkatef umamshich letocho tisha asar sea mayim sheuvim vechasher, hoil veharov mayim kesherim. vechen halacha:

Hamesannek. kemo hamesallek. shemmesallek et hattit letzad echad. velo shettalash hattit min hammayim, ella vetoch hammayim silleko letzad echad. sheim telasho min hammayim necheshav keshauv, veim mashchu mimmennu shelosha luggin posel et hammikve. vedavka chesheen bammikve arbaim sea, hu dishlosha luggin mayim sheuvin poslin et hammikve. aval im hayu vo arbaim sea, en kol mayim sheuvin shebbaolam poslin oto:
Verabbi shimon machshir. mishshum deen mitkavven lashsheiva ella lesallek et hattit lemakom echad. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Rabbi yose omer kulei. velaze log umechetza venitarvu. vahare yesh kan shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin shehen poslin et hammikve, af al pi chen kesherin:
Shello nikra alehem shem pesul. sheim hayu mosifin mayim kesherin bechol echad ad tashlum shiur shel mikve, haya chol echad mehen kasher:
Venechelak lishnayim. vehosifu vechol echad mayim kesherim ad sheyyesh bechol echad mehem keshiur mikve:
Pasul. kol echad mehen:
Vechasar afillu kortov. leachar shennaflu alav shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin metzumtzamim nechsar mimmennu afillu kortov shel mayim:
Kasher. lehosif alav mayim ulehashlimo leshiur mikve. shei efshar shebbeoto kortov shechasar, lo chaser meat min hashshelosha luggin, venimtza shello haya vo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin:
Kortov. chelek mishshishshim ballog:
Ad sheyyetze mimmennu meloo. hammayim shehayu vo techilla keshennaflu vo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin:

Vaod. meat yoter kede lechasser mishshelosha luggin. kegon mikve shehayu vo esrim sea mayim kesherim venaflu letocho shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin venitmalle achar kach me geshamim, leolam hu vifsulo ad sheyyotzi mimmennu esrim sea shehayu sham techilla, veod meat yoter, lemaet shelosha luggin:

Lenaggevan. targum vehinne charvu, veha neguvu. vedavka lenaggevan, shello nitkavven lekabbel hammayim, lechach lo naasu sheuvim, dichtiv [vayyikra 11] ach mayan uvor, ma mayan sheen bo tefisat yede adam, af bor sheen bo tefisat yede adam:
Im onat geshamim hi. shennitkashsheru shamayim beavim veyardu geshamim:
Im yesh bo chimat mayim babbor. garsinan. velo garsinan o:
Yeshabber. hakkankannim veyippelu hammayim shebbetochan labbor, dehamshacha hi, kevan shemmittoch kelim shevurim noflim labbor:
Veim lav. sheenah onat geshamim, i nammi sheen mayim babbor:

Lo yeshabber. deim enah onat geshamim hare lo yuchal laasot mikve min hammayim shebbakkankannim bilvad, disvira leh lerabbi eliezer sheuva shehimshichuha chullah o rubbah, pesula. aval keshehi onat geshamim, yeshabber lehameshich ellu hammayim veyitmalle rov hammikve beme geshamim. uchesheen bo mayim kelal, lo yeshabber af al pi shehi onat geshamim, shemma yippelu min hammayim labbor reviit kodem shevira. verabbi eliezer letameh deamar leel reviit mayim poslim et hammikve (lechattechilla) [battechilla]:

Rabbi yehoshua omer ben kach uven kach yeshabber. dekasavar shelosha luggin poslin et hammikve ben battechilla ben bassof, velo reviit, velo chayshinan shemma yippelu labbor shelosha luggin kodem shevira. veaf al gav delav onat geshamim hi, yeshabber, deyachol lehameshich ad shiur mikve, dekasavar sheuva shehimshichah kullah, tehora. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
O yichpe. shekkofe hakkankannim sheal haggag shello yippelu hammayim mittochan labbor, ella yippelu letzad acher umishsham nimshachim labbor:
Aval lo yeare. sheim higbiah hakkankannim veera otan, naasu chemayim sheuvin, shehare yesh bahen tefisat yede adam:
Hanneor ballayla vehamehallech badderech yechidi. umechashshev belibbo divre havay:

Hare ze mitchayyev benafsho. lefi shellayla hu zeman lammazzikim, vehamehallech badderech yechidi hu besakkana mippene hallistim vechamma pegaim raim, veim haya mechashshev bedivre tora hayta meshammarto:

Bet shammay poslin. vahalacha kevet shammay, ben besukka gedola vehu yoshev al petach hassukka veshulchano betoch habbayit, ben besukka ketanna sheenah machzeket rosho verubbo veshulchano, hakkol asur, gezera shemma yimmashech achar shulchano:
Veamru haalum lassukka. velo min haddin, ella shehechmiru al atzman. veshaminan mina shehammachmir al atzmo shello leechol afillu achilat aray chutz lassukka, hare ze meshubbach:

Ochel pachot mikkabbetza [netalo bammappa]. mishshum netilat yadayim, umishshum baroche natal pachot mikkabbetza. deillu mishshum sukka ha amrinan ochlim achilat aray chutz lassukka vaafillu yoter mikkabbetza:
Im en ani li. im en ani zoche leatzmi, mi yizke bishvili:
Uchesheani leatzmi. vaafillu zachiti leatzmi, ma hu hazzechut hazze uvamme nechshav hu keneged ma sheani chayyav laasot:
Veim lo achshav. baolam hazze:
Ematay. ki achar hammavet i efshar lizkot od. perush acher, im lo achshav bime habbacharut, ematay, shemma bime hazzikna lo yaale leyadi:
Ubbara shehericha. haubbar meriach reach hattavshil vehi mitavva lo, veim enah ochelet shenehem mesukkanim:
Al pi vekiim. rofim mumchin beummanutan:

En sham bekiin maachilin oto al pi atzmo. hachi mipparshah matnitin baggemara, bamme devarim amurim desomchin al divre bekiin, bizman shehachole omer eni tzarich o shotek, aval amar tzarich, en sham bekiin kelal, kelomar en bekiutan chashuva lichlum, aval maachilin oto al pi atzmo, veaf al pi shehabbekiin omrim eno tzarich:
Ayin hara. kemo ayin raa, sheeno mistappek bema sheyyesh lo umechazzer achar devarim acherim. veyesh mefarshim ayin hara, shemmachnis ayin hara bemamon chavero o bevanav umazzik lo:
Vesinat habberiyyot. sinat chinnam. verambam peresh, shemmoes chevrat habberiyyot veohev leshev yechidi. vaani shamati, adam kashe shemmevi alav sinat habberiyyot vegorem shehakkol sonim oto:

Sheyyaamid bechatzer arbaim sea. mikve chasher lematta min happasul, ufotkan lakkasher kede sheyyitchabberu, veyithar haelyon happasul min hattachton hakkasher, deamrinan gud assek. vechol shekken im hakkasher lemala vehappasul lematta, deamrinan gud achet:

Ella im ken pasak. sheppasku memav veyatzu mimmennu meloo veod kedaamaran. veyesh gorsim ella im ken pakak, kelomar ella im ken satam al hammikve asher asa ad shello yigga echad beelle hammayim. vegirsa rishona nire li ikkar. veen halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya:
Mayim mukkin. mayim novim shehen meluchim o chammim:
Shehen metaharim bezochalin. veillu mayan shemmemav muatim dilel eno metaher bezochalin ella veashboren:
Mayim chayyim. novim sheenan mukkin:
Shehen tevila lazzavim. dichtiv (Vayikra 15) verachatz et besaro bemayim chayyim:
Vehazzaya lamtzoraim. dichtiv behu (sham 14) el keli cheres al mayim chayyim:
Uchesherim lekaddesh bahen me chattat. dichtiv behu (Bamidbar 19) mayim chayyim el keli:
Derech eretz. melacha o sechora:
Sheyyegiat shenehem meshakkachat avon. shehattora matteshet kocho shel adam, vehammelacha mefarechet umeshabberet et hagguf, umittoch kach yetzer hara batel mimmennu:

Vechol tora sheen immah melacha. veim tomar yehe amel battora tamid vigiatah tehe meshakkachat avon, uma tzorech lammelacha, lechach huzkak lomar vechol tora sheen immah melacha sofah betela, lefi shei efshar lo belo mezonot, umelastem et habberiyyot umeshakkeach talmudo:
Yihyu oskin immahem leshem shamayim. velo kede littol atara lomar kach vechach asiti bishvil hatztzibbur:
Shezzechut avotam mesayyatan. shezzechut avotan shel tzibbur vetzidkatan haomedet laad hi hamesayyaat el haoskin immahen lehotzi laor tzidkan, velo mitztzad tuv hishtaddelutan shel haoskim:

Veattem maale ani alechem sachar. af al pi sheen haddavar ba lide gemar tov mitztzad maasechem ella bishvil zechut avotam shel tzibbur, maale ani alechem sachar keillu attem asitem hayeshua hazzot beyisrael, hoil veattem oskim leshem shamayim. perush acher, kol haoskim im hatztzibbur lehacheriach velachof et hatztzibbur lidvar mitzva litzdaka o lefidyon shevuyim, yihyu oskim immahem leshem shamayim, shezzechut avot shel tzibbur mesayyatan latet ma sheppasku alehem vaafillu mamon harebe, vehatztzedaka sheyyaasu taamod lahem laad. veattem hammitassekim lachof et hatztzibbur lemitzva zo, maale ani alechem sachar keillu asitem zot hammitzva mimmamonchem mammash. verambam peresh, veattem maale ani alechem sachar keillu asitem, im beshaa sheattem oskim im hatztzibbur nitbattaltem measiyyat ezo mitzva bishvil iske hatztzibbur, maale ani alechem sachar keillu asitem otah mitzva shennitbattaltem mimmennah:
Vachavile zeradin. min kanim, uveodan lachim behema ochaltan, uchesheyyavshu omdin lehessek:

En mesakkechin. keshehen keshurim. velo mippene shehen pesulim, ella peamim sheadam ba vachavilato al ketefo umaalah umannichah al gabbe sukka leyabbeshah, venimlach aleha lesikkuch, vehattora amra taase velo min heasuy bifsul, veze lo naasa afillu letzel ella leyabbesh, vehave asuy bifsul:
Vechullan. happesulim sheshshaninu bischach:
Kesherim laddefanot. desukka sechach mashma velo defanot. hilkach sukkot taase lecha miggarnecha, assechach mashma velo addefanot:
Bur. rek mikkol davar, vaafillu betiv massa umattan eno yodea. vehu garua meam haaretz. targum vehaadama lo tesham (Bereshit 47), veara lo tevur:
Velo am haaretz chasid. aval yere chet efshar sheyyihye, shehare hu baki betiv massa umattan:
Velo habbayshan lamed. shehammitbayyesh lishol shemma yaligu alav, yishshaer tamid bisfekotav:
Velo hakkappedan. harav shemmakpid al hattalmidim kesheshshoalim oto, lo yelammed karauy. ella tzarich sheyyasbir panim bahalacha letalmidav:
Velo chol hammarbe vischora machkim. dichtiv (Devarim 30) velo meever layyam hi, en hattora metzuya beotam sheholchim meever layyam (eruvin noah.):
Uvemakom sheen anashim. leshev barosh ulehorot horaot:
Hattame sheyyarad litbol. sefeko tame. deoke gavra achezkateh uvechezkat tuma hu:

Sukka shehi gevoha lemala meesrim amma pesula. desukka dirat aray bainan, dichtiv (Devarim 16) chag hassukkot taase lecha shivat yamim, amra tora ase sukka leshivat yamim. ulemala meesrim amma en adam ose dirato dirat aray, ella dirat keva:
Verabbi yehuda machshir. desavar sukka dirat keva bainan. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Vesheenah gevoha asara tefachim pesula. dedira serucha hi, veen adam dar bedira serucha:

Vesheen lah shalosh defanot. dichtiv bassukkot bassukkot bassukkot, shenayim chaserim veechad male, chad lassechach, deferush sukka sechach, pashu lehu telata leshalosh defanot. atya halacha lemoshe missinay uvatztzereh ledofen chada veokmeh attefach, nisharu shetayim kehilchatan, ushelishit afillu tefach. lefichach sukka sheyyesh lah shete defanot zo etzel zo, ose dofen shelishit sheyyesh bo tefach umashshehu, umaamido befachot mishshelosha samuch leechad mishte haddefanot, shekkol pachot mishshelosha kelavud dami, venechshav keillu hu dofen shel arbaa tefachim, venimtza rov dofen asuy, vahare yesh lesukka zo shalosh defanot. vetzarich laasot lah tzurat petach. veim shete haddefanot hem zo keneged zo uvenehen mefullash, mevi pas sheyyesh bo arbaa tefachim umashshehu, umaamido befachot mishshelosha samuch leechad mishte haddefanot, venechshav keillu yesh befas ze shiva tefachim, shehu shiur hechsher sukka learkah ulerachbah, shehassukka tzericha shettehe shiva al shiva kede shettehe machzeket rosho verubbo veshulchano, shishsha al shishsha lerosho verubbo, vetefach al tefach leshulchano:

Veshechammatah merubba mitztzillatah pesula. ha beshavin, shehachamma katztzel keshera, vedavka shehen shavin millematta bekarkait hassukka, divyadua shellemala bassechach tzillatah merubba mechammatah, deamre eynashe kezuza milleel keistira millera:

Bet shammay poslin. devau sukka lishmah, vezo setam naaset. veillu toch sheloshim lechag kevan sheshshoalim behilchot hechag sheloshim yom kodem lechag, setam haose sukka leshem chag hu ose, aval kodem sheloshim setama lav leshem chag hu:
Uvet hillel machshirin. delo bau sukka leshem chag:
Mille vichli tame. leel ashmeinan keshehattuma vaa lammayim mechamat adam tame, vehacha ashmeinan keshehattuma vaa mechamat keli [tame]:
Ayin tova. mistappek bema sheyyesh lo veeno mevakkesh devarim yeterim veeno mekanne kesheroe sheyyesh lachaverav yoter mimmennu:
Chaver tov. shemmochicho kesheroe oto ose davar sheeno hagun:
Shachen tov. matzuy etzlo ben bayyom ben ballayla, veillu chaver tov eno matzuy etzlo bechol et:
Haroe et hannolad. tzofe umabbit bema sheatid lihyot, umittoch kach nimtza mechashshev hefsed mitzva keneged secharah usechar avera keneged hefsedah:

Lev tov. lefi shehallev hu hammenia lechol shear hakkochot vehu hammakor shemmimmennu novim kol happeullot. veaf al pi sheyyesh lappeullot evarim meyuchadim, mikkol makom hakkoach hameorer lechol hattenuot hu ballev, lefichach amar rabbi elazar lev tov. umifne ze amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay roe ani et divre elazar ben arach middivrechem:

Ezo hi derech raa sheyyitrachek mimmenna haadam. hutzrach lishol mehem ze, velo hevin mittoch divrehem harishonim shehadderech haraa hi hefech hadderech hattova, lefi shello kol ma shehu tov yihye hefcho ra, ki middat hachasidut vehu haose lifnim mishshurat haddin hi tova, umi sheeno chasid umaamid devarav al din tora eno ra, veefshar haya lomar, sheim hahistappekut vehi ayin tova hi derech tova, bakkashat hayyitronot eno derech raa, lefi sheeno mazzik leshum adam baze, vechen bishar hammiddot. lefichach hutzrach lishol mehem ezo hi derech raa sheyyitrachek mimmenna haadam:

Hallo veeno meshallem. hu hefech haroe et hannolad, sheim lo yeshallem lo yimtza mi sheyyalvennu veyihye muttal baraav. velo amar setam mi sheeno roe et hannolad, lefi sheefshar laadam sheeno roe et hannolad shello yavo lide takkala, sheyyatztzil atzmo bevo hannolad hahu:
Vetzaddik chonen venoten. hakkadosh baruch hu shehu tzaddiko shel olam chonen venoten lammalve ma shellava ze mimmennu velo para lo, nimtza hallo nishar chayyav lammakom:
Heve zahir bikriat shema. likroto beonato. vechen battefilla, lehitpallel kol tefilla utefilla beonatah:

Keva. keadam sheyyesh alav chova davar kavua veomer ematay efrok mealay chov ze. i nammi, keva, keadam shekkavua lo likro perek echad parasha achat, sheomer otah bikria bealma, veeno omrah bilshon tachanunim keadam shemmevakkesh rachamim:
Ki el channun verachum hu. rotze betachanunim, veal yede hattachanunim hu merachem miyyad:

Veal tehi rasha bifne atzmecha. al taase davar shehayyom ulemachar tarshia et atzmecha bo. veharambam peresh, al tehi rasha beenecha kelomar lo tachazik atzmecha kerasha, shemmittoch kach atta yotze letarbut raa legamre. vaani shamati, al tehi rasha bedavar ze shettifrosh min hatztzibbur vetaamod bifne atzmecha:
Al daateft atfuch. rasha hayita umelastem et habberiyyot umetzifan bannahar, uveotah midda maddu lecha:

Vesof metifayich yetufun. shello haya haddavar masur beyadan lehargecha, ella levet din, vehakkadosh baruch hu mesarcha beyadan, shemmegalgelim chova al yede chayyav, veatid hu achar kach litboa mehen mitatcha:
Shappudin. en reuyin lesikkuch, lefi sheenan giddule karka:
[Baarukkot] hammitta. kelim hamekabbelim tuma:

Im yesh revach benehen kemotan. lav davka kemotan mammash velo yoter, deha mekom shappud kefarutz hu nechshav, ucheshennoten sechach kasher ben shappud leshappud im en benehen ella kemotan have parutz keomed ufasul. ella al karchacha harevach shebbenehen mashshehu yoter mikkemotan:

Hachotet begadish. natal min hoomarim lematta samuch laaretz veasa chalal keshiur sukka, vehassechach nimtza asuy veomed meelav, vehattora amra taase velo min heasuy. aval im haya bo chalal tefach bemeshech shiva, asuy leshem sechach, vechittet bo ad shehigbiah et hechalal leshiur gova asara, [en] zo hi asiyyato, shehare eno metakken ella haddefanot, uvaddefanot lo amrinan taase velo min heasuy, vahare hi kesukka pechuta measara vechakak bah lehashelimah laasara:
Haolam omed. yishshuvan shel bene adam mitkayyem. en ze kemo haolam omed dilel:
Al haddin. lezakkot et hazzakkay ulechayyev et hachayyav:
Veal haemet. shello yeshakkeru ish baamito:
Veal hashshalom. ben hammalchuyyot, uven adam lachavero:
Berosh haagala. af al gav demittaltela velo kevii:
Berosh hassefina. shebbayyam, sheharuach sholetet sham veokartah:
Keshera. dedira karina beh. vehu shettehe yechola laamod beruach metzuya shel yabbasha:
Veolin lah beyom tov. ayde devae lemitne sefa en olin, tana resha olin:
Berosh hailan. tikken moshavo berosho veasa sham mechitztzot vesikkech:
Keshera. bechullo shel moed:
Veen olin lah beyom tov. degazur rabbanan deen olin bailan veen mishtamshin bo, shemma yitlosh:

Shetayim bailan. samach karka hassukka rubbah bailan, veasa sevivah berosh hailan shete defanot, veachat asa bide adam baaretz, vesamach karkait hassukka beemtza haddofen sheasa baaretz, vehigbiah haddofen mimmenna vamala asara:
O shetayim bide adam veachat bailan. hoil veim yinnatel tippol karkait hassukka, sheen yechola laamod bismichat shetayim shebbaaretz, en olin lah beyom tov, demishtammesh bailan:
Hayyom katzar. chayye haolam hazze ketzarim hem:
Vehammelacha merubba. hattora arukka meeretz middah:
Uvaal habbayit dochek. shenneemar (Yehoshua 1) vehagita bo yomam valayla:
Hayyashen. lo yatza yede chovato. uvilvad shettehe hammitta gevoha asara tefachim, deaz hi chashuva ohel, venimtza ohel mafsik beno leven hassukka. veikkar mitzvat sukka achila shetiyya shena:
Nohagim hayinu kulei. dekasavar lo ate ohel aray umevattel ohel keva. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Avadim peturim min hassukka. demitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot, vechol mitzva shehaishsha chayyevet bah eved chayyav bah:
Ulefi darkenu lamadnu. af al pi shello amar ella lesichat chullin bealma, shehaya mishtabbeach beavdo, lamadnu shehayyashen tachat hammitta kulei:
Velo amru alav divre tora. uvevirkat hammazon shemmevarchim al hashshulchan, yotzin yede chovatan, vechashuv keillu amru alav divre tora. kach shamati:
Mizzivche metim. tikrovet avoda zara, dichtiv (tehillim kav) vayyitztzamdu levaal peor vayyochlu zivche metim:
Malu ki tzoa. vaavoda zara keruya tzoa, dichtiv (yeshaya 30) tze tomar lo:
Beli makom. bishvil shello hizkiru shemo shel makom baruch hu al hashshulchan:

Shenneemar vayyedabber elay ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai. miyyad kesheddibber bedivre tora nikra shulchan asher lifne Adonai. veyesh omrim merosho shel mikra hu yotze, dichtiv vehammizbeach etz shalosh ammot, al tikre ammot ella immot, kemo yesh em lammikra, shalosh keneged tora neviim uchetuvim, veamre la mikra mishna vetalmud. shetztzarich adam ledabber bahen al hashshulchan, veaz karuy shulchan asher lifne Adonai. kach peresh Rashi:
Tikra. gag heasuy mikkorot o nesarim:
Maaziva. hattit o hassid shergilin litten al gabbe hakkorot vehannesarim karuy maaziva:
Mefakpek. soter umenanea kullan:
O notel achat mibbentayim. venoten sechach kasher bimkomah. verabbi yehuda letaameh demachshir lesakkech binsarim, hilkach befikpuk saggi. uvelo pikpuk i efshar, mishshum taase velo min heasuy:

Rabbi meir omer. lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel bedavar ze, shekkullan modim shetztzarich littol echad mibbentayim ufikpuk eno moil. verabbi meir letaameh deamar en mesakkechin binsarim. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum bet hillel:
Shel log log. log echad bechol gumma:

Ad shello higgiu legumma shelishit kasher. dahave leh kemikve shalem shennaflu letocho shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin delo fesaluhu, vehacha nammi hoil vehayu vammikve arbaim sea kodem shehiggiu hammayim legumma shelishit, lo nifsal hammikve:

Kemikve samuch lemikve. kemikve chasher hassamuch leshauv, shezze omed bechashruto veze omed befasluto, vehacha nammi hammayim shebbaggummot keomdim bifne atzmam chashive velo chimoravin. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Hamesadder kankannim babbor venitmalleu af al pi shebbala habbor et memav. veen mayim babbor ella ellu shebbakkankannim:
Hare ze yeshabber. kerabbi yehoshua deen reviit posel, umeshabber et hakkankannim veose mikve vattechilla:
Hidla aleha. higbiah al gabbah:
Kissom. 216 belaaz, vehi nidla kegefen vechidlaat:
Pesula. lefi sheen mesakkechin bimchubbar:

Veim haya hassikkuch harebe mehem. shehaya sham sechach kasher harebe yoter mehaggefen vehaddelaat, keshera. vehu shechavatan veervan im hassechach kasher veen nirin beayin, dischach kasher rabbe alehen umevattelan keshehen meoravin:

O shekketzatzan. af leachar shessikkech bahen, keshera. vehu sheyyenaneem leachar ketzitza, dei lav hachi pesula, deamra tora (Devarim 16) chag hassukkot taase, velo min heasuy, kelomar keshettaase tehe rauy lesukka, velo min heasuy bifsul, sheen rauy lesukka veatta metakkenah, ki ha demachshar la biktzitza velo hadar satar la. aval keshemmenaanea have kesoter vechozer umesakkech, shemmagbiah kol echad levad umannicho vechozer umagbiah et chavero umannicho:
Kol davar sheeno kulei. laafoke kele etz uvigde pishtan umachtzelaot, sheaf al pi sheggiddulehem min haaretz en mesakkechin bahen, hoil umekabbelin tuma:

Vegiddulav min haaretz vechulei. dichtiv chag hassukkot [taase lecha beaspecha] miggarnecha umiyyikvecha, bifsolet goren vayekev hakkatuv medabber, kelomar min hannishar achar sheasafta haggoren vehayyekev, kegon kashshin uzemorot, mehem ase sukka:
Vehaamma nichneset lo. kegon me geshamim shebbau min hammidron venichnasim lo:
Hassochet et kesuto. vehammayim shehayu nivlaim bo chashive mayim sheuvim, ucheshehu sochatan letoch habbor hen bain mimmekomot harebe shemmikkan umikkan labbeged:
Vehammeare min hatztzartzur. keli cheres sheosin al piv sevacha kemin michbar maase reshet, vehameare mimmennu mattil hammayim mimmekomot harebe:
Rabbi akiva machshir. kasavar deen shelosha luggim mayim sheuvin poslin et hammikve ella im ken mattilan lammikve mikkeli echad umimmakom echad, ma sheen ken bichsut vetzartzur:
Vachachamim poslim. desavre shelosha chelim mitztarfin:
Lo amru mattilin ella mattil. kol ze kibbel rabbi akiva merabbotav, dichli hammattil shelosha luggin mayim lammikve posel et hammikve:
Velo chach amru ella shennaflu. velo shena mikkeli echad o mikkelim harebe. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:
Al tachazik tova leatzmecha. lomar harebe tora lamadti. ulefi shehu lo hinniach lo mikra velo mishna halacha veaggada shello lamad (sukka koach., bava batra 134.), haya omer ken:
Bor sud. garsinan, velo bor sid. kelomar, kevor tuach besid:
Sheeno meabbed tippa. kach hu eno shocheach davar echad mittalmudo:

Ashre yoladto. meushshar bemiddot tovot ad shekkol haolam omrim alav ashre mi sheyyeladattu. veyesh omrim, al shem shehi garma lo sheyyehe chacham, shehayta mechazzeret al kol batte midrashot shebbeirah veomeret lahem bevakkasha mikkem bakkeshu rachamim al haubbar hazze shebbemeay sheyyihye chacham, umiyyom shennolad lo hotzia arasto mibbet hammidrash kede shello yikkansu beaznav ella divre tora:
Chasid. sheose lifnim mishshurat haddin:
Yere chet. machmir al atzmo veoser alav devarim hammuttarim, miyyirato shemma yavo lide chet. deim lo chen may revuteh, afillu am haaretz efshar lihyot yere chet:
Mayan hammitgabber. libbo rachav umosif pilpul usevarot middato:
Abba shaul omer mishshemo. shel rabban yochanan ben zakkay:

Veelazar ben arach bechaf sheniyya. matzati katuv, deabba shaul lo nechlak al tanna kamma, ushene haddevarim amaram rabban yochanan ben zakkay, ushenehem emet, dilinyan habbekiut vehazzikkaron haya rabbi eliezer machria, uleinyan hacharifut vehappilpul haya rabbi elazar ben arach machria:

Mesakkechin binsarim divre rabbi yehuda. binsarim sheyyesh bahem arbaa, shehu shiur makom chashuv, divre hakkol pesula. pachot mishshelosha, divre hakkol keshera, dachashive kekanim. ki felige mishshelosha vead arbaa. rabbi yehuda savar kevan delet behu shiur makom chashuv lo gazrinan shemma yeshev tachat tikrat habbayit. verabbi meir savar kevan denafke mittorat lavud gazrinan shemma yomar ma li lesakkech beellu ma li leshev tachat tikrat beti. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Sefek mayim sheuvim shettiharu chachamim. bemassechet tohorot perek hazzorek tuma, taman teninan, ellu sefekot shettiharu chachamim safek mayim sheuvin lammikve:
Safek naflu. shelosha luggin mayim sheuvim bemikve chaser:
Safek yesh bahen arbaim sea. kelomar safek haya vammikve arbaim sea chesherim kodem shennaflu hashsheuvin, deshuv en hashsheuvin poslin oto:
Sheyyesh lo vamme yitle. sheyyesh lo makom litlot nefilatan shello garmu lo fesul:

Sheen lo vamme yitle. dema nafshach behe minnayhu denafal pesaluhu, hilkach shenehem pesulin. vehay dimtaharinan hacha sefek mayim sheuvin bemakom sheyyesh lo vamme litlot, hayenu mishshum dishuvin derabbanan. veha detanya vetorat kohanim ach mayan uvor mikve mayim, ma mayan bide shamayim af mikve vide shamayim, asmachta vealma hi:
Velo matzati lagguf tov ella shetika. mi sheshshomea cherpato veshotek:

Velo hammidrash hu haikkar ella hammaase. veteda lecha shehashshetika tova, sheafillu hammidrash vehadderash vehaddibbur battora sheen lecha midda tova hemenna, en ikkar kibbul hassachar ella bishvil hammaase, vehaddoresh veeno mekayyem, noach lo im haya shotek velo haya doresh:

Vechol hammarbe devarim mevi chet. shekken matzinu bechavva shehirbeta devarim, veamra, amar elohim lo tochlu mimmennu velo tigu bo, vehosifa negia shello neesra bah, udechafah nachash ad shennaga bo, veamar lah, keshem sheen mita bingia kach en mita baachila, umittoch kach baat lide chet, sheachla min happeri. hu sheshshelomo omer (Mishlei 30) al tosef al devarav pen yochiach becha venichzavta:
Hameshalshel. morid. shehitchil leerog haddefanot samuch lassechach veoreg uva kelappe matta:
Shelosha tefachim pesula. hayenu shiur sheyyizdakker haggedi bevat achat veyikkanes, deamran devichhay gavna enah mechitztza:
Kevan shehiggia laasara keshera. vaafillu enan maggiot lassechach umuflagot mimmennu harebe:
Rabbi yose omer keshem shemmillematta lemala. dayyo baarigat asara:
Kach milmala lematta. vaafillu gevohot min haaretz harebe. desavar mechitztza teluya mutteret. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Hirchik et hassikkuch. lav baggova kaamar, ella barochav, shehinniach avir ben dofen lassechach, beorech hassukka o berachbah:
Hateken atzmecha lilmod tora. shello tomar hoil veavi chacham vaavi avi chacham, tora chozeret leachsanya shellah veeni tzarich levakkesh achareha:
Vechol maasecha yihyu leshem shamayim. af beshaa sheatta osek baachila ushetiyya uvederech eretz lo titkavven lehahanot gufecha, ella shettihye bari laasot retzon koncha:

Hachotet betzinnor. derech tzinnor lihyot patuach mishshene tzedadim, veen posel et hammikve ella im ken chakak bo chakak meat kede lekabbel tzerorot hameakkevim hilluch hammayim, ucheshechakako ulevassof kevao ayre, hoil vehaya alav torat keli cheshehaya talush, hare hammayim haovrim bo sheuvim hen ufoslim et hammikve:
Uveshel cheres. la chashiv keli ella im ken yesh lo vet kibbul shel reviit:

Lo amru reviit ella veshivre hacheres. davka vichli cheres leachar shennishbar bainan sheyyehe hashshever machazik reviit. aval mittechillato afillu chol shehu chashuv keli. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Mitchalchalim. mitgalgelim betoch bet kibbul, sheenam mehuddakim bo af al pi shennitmalle mehem ella mitnaneim elach vaelach. leshon vattitchalchal hammalka (Ester 4):
Poslin et hammikve. delo nitbattel kibbulo:
Yarad letocho. letoch bet kibbulo:
Afar venichbash. sheheafar nikba venaasa mehuddak yafe vehammayim ovrim alav. targum bammesilla naale (Bamidbar 20) beorach kevisha nissak:
Kasher. deen kan bet kibbul:
Sillon vetzinnor umarzev. echad hu:
Shehu tzar mikkan umikkan. mishshene fiyyotav, mimmakom shehammayim nichnasim bo umimmakom sheyyordim mimmennu lammikve:
Verachav baemtza. afillu hachi la chashiv lekabbala kol zeman shello chakak bo lekabbel tzerorot:

Hem amru shelosha devarim. bederech eretz uvemusarim uvemiddot. deillu beinyan haasur vehammuttar vehappetur vehachiyyuv devarim harebe amru. i nammi, ellu hashshelosha devarim have margela befumayhu tamid:

Yehi chevod chavercha chaviv alecha keshellach. veematay yehe ze, keshello tehi noach lichos, sheim atta noach lichos i efshar shello tezalzel bichvod chavercha. hare dibbur echad. veshuv yom echad lifne mitatcha, hare shenayim. vehashshelishi, heve mitchammem keneged uran shel chachamim vechulei:
Shuv yom echad lifne mitatecha. ulefi sheen adam yodea ematay yamut, yaase teshuva hayyom shemma yamut lemachar:
Veheve zahir begachaltan. shello tinhag bahen kallut rosh:
Shello tikkave. shello teanesh al yadan:
Neshichat shual. refuato kasha, lefi sheshshinnav dakkot akummot vaakushshot vetzarich harofe lachtoch habbasar beizmel uleharchiv hanneshicha:
Akitzat akrav. kasha minneshichat nachash:
Ulechishatan. dibburan:

Lechishat saraf. kehevel hayyotze mippi hassaraf, shessoref beshaa shehu lochesh. perush acher, hassaraf hazze eno mekabbel lachash kishar nechashim, kedichtiv (tehillim noach) asher lo yishma lekol melachashim, kach talmid chacham im taknitennu vetavo lefayyeso eno mekabbel piyyus:

Vehailanot defanot lah keshera. vehu shehailanot avim vachazakim velo azle veatu beruach metzuya. vetzarich nammi lemalleot ben haanafim beteven vakash shello tezizem haruach, shekkol mechitztza sheenah yechola laamod beruach metzuya enah mechitztza:

Sheluche mitzva peturim. shehaosek bemitzva patur min hammitzva. velo bilvad beshaa sheoskin bammitzva peturim, ella afillu beshaa sheen asukim bah, kegon holech lehakebil pene rabbo o lefidyon shevuyim, patur af bishat chaniyyato:

Cholin umeshammeshehen peturim. vaafillu becholi kol dehu. vehay deshare levattel mitzvat ase shel tora mippene choli kol dehu, umitztaer mippene reach ra o mippene pishpeshim ufaroshim shehu patur, vechen holche derachim veshomre ginnot ufardesim defatre lehu rabbanan min hassukka, taama have mishshum dichtiv (Vayikra 23) bassukkot teshvu, keen taduru, vechol hecha deit leh mide shemmippene oto davar haya yotze middirato, yachol nammi latzet missukkato. aval haose sukkato mittechilla bemakom harauy lehitztaer baachila o beshena, kegon bemakom shemmityare bo mippene listim bashshena veen mityare mippene haggannavim o listim baachila, afillu baachila lo yatza yede chovato beotah sukka, hoil veenah reuya laasot bo kol tzerachav, achila ushetiyya veshena, deha keen taduru bainan veha lo have keen dira:
Ochlim veshotim aray. davar muat lehasir raavono, vedato lisod achar ken:

Me tamtziyyot shello fasku. heharim mizzechilatan vaadayin hen mevatzbetzin meme haggeshamim sheyyardu alehen, ellu mevattelim hattippa harishona hattemea shehayta vaggeve. lefichach shata tame veshata tahor kol zeman shello fasku, tahor, demayim temeim shennaflu sham, nitharu. vezo hi hammaala, dehane dilel lo alta tevila lammayim hattemeim, veillu hacha alta. aval en kesherim litvilat adam vechelim veyadayim:
Hevu zehirim barashut. attem hammitassekim betzarche tzibbur, af al pi sheattem tzerichim lehitvaddea larashut kede lefakkeach al iske rabbim, hevu zehirim vechulei:

Rabbi yehoshua omer battit uvammayim. keshehammayim tzafim al gabbe hattit vaafillu raglav shokot battit matbilin lerabbi yehoshua, mippene shehammayim makdimim. verabbi eliezer let leh hay sevara. aval im haya matbil keli katan bammayim hatztzafim al gabbe hattit, beha mode rabbi eliezer dealta lo tevila, kevan shello haya shokea battit kelal umitztaref lehashelim arbaim sea. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Shehakkane yored meelav. shehu rach venimmoach kol kach sheim yasimu vo kane yishka battit meelav:
Mekom sheen kene hammidda omed. kane shemmoddin bo eno omed meelav betocho, veze eno rach venimmoach karishon:
Mishkolet. bedil shel habbannaim. vechol hashshiurin hallalu kol echad mosif bekoshi hattit veavyo, sheharishon rach mikkullam, vehashsheni kashe hemennu, vehashshelishi kashe hemennu, vechen kullam:
Befi chavit. sheppiha tzar vekatan. veim hattit rach kol kach sheyyachol lishshafech ulehikkanes bappi hatztzar shel chavit, alta lo tevila:

Shefoferet hannod. shefoferet shel kane shemmannichin al pi hannod sheshshofchim letocho. veshiur hannekev shel shefoferet hannod, sheyyihyu chozrot bo shete etzbaot benoniyyot, shehen rochav shete etzbaot harishonot shel pas hayyad, lo haggudal:
Hannimdad ballog. kol zeman shehu rach kol kach shehu nimdad ballog vehu cheli shemmachazik shesh betzim, hu nimdad im hammikve vetovlin bo. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Battechilla. shello haya vammikve mayim kelal keshennafal bo reviit mayim sheuvin, venishlam achar kach shiuro veme geshamim:
Al pene hammayim. leachar shehayu vo harebe mayim kesherim:
Vachachamim omrim. vahalacha kachachamim:

Marbe vasar marbe rimma. hammarbe baachila ushetiyya ad shennaase shamen uvaal basar, marbe alav rimma bakkever, vekasha rimma lammet kemachat bivsar hachay. vekamashma lan hay tanna, shekkol ribbuyin kashim laadam chutz meribbuy tora vechachma utzedaka:

Marbe deaga. shemma yigzeluhu mibbet hammelech o shemma yavou alav listim veyaharguhu. vechasid echad haya mitpallel, hammakom yatztzileni mippizzur hannefesh. veshaalu mimmennu mahu pizzur hannefesh, amar lahem sheyyihyu lo nechasim merubbim mefuzzarim bimkomot harebe vetzarich lefazzer nafsho lachashov lechan ulechan:

Marbe nashim marbe cheshafim. sidra naket veazel. bitchilla adam mekashshet atzmo veochel veshote umarbe basar, veachar kach mevakkesh leharebot nechasim, uleachar shehirba nechasim veroe sheyyesh beyado sippuk lefarnes nashim rabbot hu marbe lo nashim, uleachar shehirba nashim kol achat tzericha shifcha shetteshammeshennah, hare marbe shefachot, vechevan sheyyesh lo vene bayit merubbin tzarich lesadot ucheramim lesappek yayin umazon livne beto, umarbe avadim laavod hassadot vehakkeramim. lechach hen shenuyin beseder ze:
Marbe torah marbe chayyim. dichtiv (Devarim 30) ki hi chayyecha veorech yamecha:
Marbe chachma. shennoten taam lidvarav vehassevarot shello mityashshevot al lev hashshomin:
Marbe yeshiva. harebe talmidim mitkabbetzim uvaim lishmoa sevarotav. veit degarse, marbe yeshiva marbe chachma, mi shemmarbe betalmidim, hattalmidim mechaddedim oto umarbin umosifin al chachmato:
Marbe etza. mi shemmarbe littol etza marbe tevuna mevin davar mittoch davar meetzot sheyyoatzav notnim lo:
Marbe tzedaka marbe shalom. shenneemar (yeshaya lev) vehaya maase hatztzedaka shalom:
Keillu asaah betoch habbayit. ufesula:
Tachtona pesula. dishne sechachin yesh lah. ukera ka pasil sukka shettachat hassukka:

Im en diyyurin baelyona. sheenah reuya ledira, kegon sheen gag hattachtona yechola lisbol karim uchesatot shel elyona. velo nechleku tanna kamma verabbi yehuda kesheenah yechola lisbol kelal, divha kulle alma modu shehattachtona keshera bischach haelyona, shehaggag shellah eno chashuv gag, velo haveya sukka shettachat hassukka. veim hi beria vichola lekabbel karim uchesatot shel elyona, kulle alma lo pelige shehi pesula. ki pelige kesheyyechola lekabbel al yede haddechak, kegon sheggag hattachtona mitnoea verofef mikkarim uchesatot shel elyona, tanna kamma savar divhachi mikkere sukka shettachat hassukka ufesula, verabbi yehuda savar kevan sheenah mekabbelet karim uchesatot shel elyona ella al yede haddechak, eno chashuv gag, veen zo sukka shettachat hassukka. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Chattat veasham vadday. mechapperim im hatteshuva. velo chash hattanna lehazekirah, demistama keshehu mevi chattato vaashamo kevar asa teshuva, sheim lo haya mitcharet lo haya mevi karban:
Asham vadday. kegon asham gezelot vaasham meilot:

Al ase veal lo taase. hannittak laase, teshuva mechapperet. aval lo taase sheyyesh bah malkot, teshuva tola veyom hakkippurim mechapper. umaskana demilleta baggemara, sheim hezid baase uvelav hannittak laase, o shagag belo taase sheyyesh bo malkot, veasa teshuva, eno zaz mishsham ad shemmochalin lo. veim hezid belav sheyyesh bo malkot, teshuva tola veyom hakkippurim mechapper. veim shagag bechayyave keretot umitot bet din, hachattat mechapperet im hatteshuva. veim hezid bahem, teshuva veyom kippurim tolin, veyissurin memarkin. vehane mille keshello chillel et hashshem, kelomar shello chata vehechti acherim, aval im chillel et hashshem, en kapparato nigmeret ad sheyyamut. vechol ze bizman sheen sham sair hammishtalleach, aval bizman sheyyesh sair hammishtalleach hu mechapper al kol haaverot, kallot vachamurot, chutz meaverot shebben adam lachavero, sheen mitkapper lo ad sheyyeratztze et chavero:
Ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim temeot. af al gav disfek tuma birshut harabbim sefeko tahor, hare sefek tohora hu velo sefek tuma:
Betuma chamura. beav hattuma shemmetammeto min hattora:
Tuma kalla. derabbanan:

Achal ochalim temeim. achal chatzi feras meochalim temeim, o shata reviit mashkin temein, nifsal gufo milleechol batteruma, ufosel et hatteruma midderabbanan. vechullan mishshemona asar davar sheggazru vo chachamim, vechullan meforashim perek kamma deshabbat:
Vaafillu taval. dehashta ikka tarte leriuta, shemma lo taval kelal, vaafillu taval, shemma kodem tevila nitchasser, afillu hachi sefeko tahor:
Rabbi yose metamme. vaafillu vetuma derabbanan. mishshum degavra vechezkat tuma:

Aval sefeko littame uletamme. kegon safek achal ochalim temeim o lo achal, hare sefeko littame, o vadday achal ochalim temeim, safek naga bechikkar shel teruma safek lo naga, hare sefeko letamme, behane metaher rabbi yose, deen kan chezkat tuma. veen halacha cherabbi yose:
